title: Sales Manager – Automotive Services Operations
description:
Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Base Salary: PHP 60,000 per month + performance incentives and team bonuses

Schedule: Rotating shifts aligned with AEST business hours

Leave: One week paid leave per year



About the Client



Our client is a leading automotive services provider in Australia, supporting motorists through urgent vehicle-related i
 with fast, professional, and customer-focused solutions.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to continue expanding their offshore operations team in the Philippines by hiring experienced leaders who can drive sales performance, oversee operations, and support team growth.



The Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced and results-driven **Sales Manager** to lead and supervise a remote customer operations and sales team supporting automotive service operations across Australia.



This role combines sales leadership, operational supervision, team coaching, and workflow management in a fast-paced environment where urgency, customer service, and conversion performance are critical.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience in inbound sales management, customer operations, and leading high-performing teams in high-pressure environments.



Key Responsibilities



Team Leadership & Performance Management



* Supervise and support the daily performance of the customer operations and sales team

* Monitor KPIs, conversion rates, sales performance, and operational efficiency

* Conduct regular coaching, feedback sessions, and performance reviews

* Provide ongoing training in customer communication, objection handling, and operational processes

* Ensure the team consistently delivers excellent customer service and achieves sales targets

* Escalate and resolve operational or customer service issues when required



Sales Oversight & Revenue Growth



* Oversee inbound sales operations and ensure strong enquiry-to-booking conversion rates

* Support the team in maximising every inbound sales opportunity

* Monitor booking accuracy and customer interactions

* Identify opportunities to improve sales performance and operational processes

* Assist in developing sales strategies and performance improvement initiatives



Operations Supervision



* Oversee live operational coordination across Australia

* Ensure urgent customer jobs are managed efficiently and accurately

* Monitor scheduling, booking updates, customer communication, and job progression

* Ensure operational workflows and procedures are followed correctly

* Support the team in handling high-pressure and time-sensitive customer situations



Quality Control & Compliance



* Review completed jobs, booking records, and operational updates for accuracy

* Identify operational gaps, missed opportunities, or workflow inefficiencies

* Maintain compliance with internal procedures and service standards

* Assist in updating templates, SOPs, and operational documentation



Collaboration & Process Improvement



* Participate in leadership meetings, training sessions, and operational planning

* Work closely with management to improve customer experience and team performance

* Support recruitment, onboarding, and mentoring of new tea
mbers

* Foster a positive, accountable, and high-performing remote team culture



What We’re Looking For



Essential Requirements



* Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in:

* Inbound sales leadership or sales management

* Automotive services, operations coordination, or customer operations

* High-volume customer service environments

* Proven experience managing or supervising remote teams

* Strong leadership, coaching, and performance management skills

* Excellent sales, objection handling, and customer communication abilities

* Ability to remain calm and solutions-focused under pressure

* Strong understanding of fast-paced operational workflows and urgent customer situations

* Excellent organisational and multitasking abilities

* Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded



* Experience in automotive services or vehicle-related operations

* Experience working with Australian customers or operations

* Knowledge of Australian geography and service coordination

* Background in transport coordination or fast-paced operational environments

* Experience with KPI reporting and operational performance analysis



What’s in It for You



* Fully remote work-from-home setup

* PHP 60,000 monthly base salary + performance incentives

* Leadership role with long-term career growth opportunities

* Ongoing training and development

* Opportunity to help scale and lead a growing international operations team

* Supportive and collaborative work culture

title: Business Operations & Executive Coordinator
description:
Eluvial Enterprise Inc. & Covington Material & Supply Co. 

Construction | Real Estate Development | Green Building Materials | Client Operations



Position Overview

Eluvial Enterprise Inc. and Covington Material & Supply Co. are seeking a highly organized, systems-oriented, and operationally driven Business Operations & Executive Coordinator to support daily business operations, client communications, estimating coordination, invoicing workflows, and executive administrative management across both companies.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant role.



This position supports active U.S.-based construction, real estate development, procurement, sustainability consulting, and building materials operations. The ideal candidate must be capable of operating in a fast-paced environment involving client management, project coordination, invoicing, operational systems management, estimating support, and procurement communication.



The Executive Coordinator will work directly under the Business Development & Relationship Manager and will play a critical role in ensuring all client communications, follow-ups, invoices, project updates, and operational systems are maintained accurately and efficiently.

This role requires someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, highly responsive, and capable of thinking operationally — not just administratively.



This Role Is NOT for Traditional Virtual Assistants

This is not a simple inbox or calendar management position.



You will be supporting active U.S.-based:

construction projects,

real estate development operations,

procurement coordination,

sustainability consulting,

estimating workflows,

and building materials transactions.

You must be comfortable working within:

operational systems,

client coordination pipelines,

invoicing workflows,

project management environments,

and fast-moving business operations.



If your experience is primarily:

social media management,

appointment setting,

customer support,

or basic administrative assistance,

this role will likely NOT be a fit.



We are looking for someone who understands operations, organization, systems, urgency, accountability, and professional client communication.



Core Responsibilities

Executive & Operational Support

Work directly with the Business Development & Relationship Manager daily.

Manage and maintain executive
 inboxes across both companies.

Ensure all client
 communications receive follow-up responses within 24 hours.



Draft, organize, and send:

client follow-ups,

invoices,

project updates,

material confirmations,

meeting recaps,

and operational communications.

Maintain high-level organization of all operational files and documentation.

Phone & Client Communication Management

Manage and monitor both company phone lines daily.

Listen to all business phone calls and identify:

pending follow-ups,

missing information,

invoice requests,

proposal needs,

and client action items.

Send all required follow-up
s and documentation after client calls.

Maintain accurate communication records and client tracking updates.

Coordinate with clients professionally and proactively throughout project workflows.



Notion Workspace & Systems Management (CRITICAL REQUIREMENT)



This is one of the most important aspects of the role.

The Executive Coordinator will be responsible for helping manage, improve, organize, and maintain the company’s Notion workspaces and operational systems.



Responsibilities include:

Building and updating Notion dashboards

Maintaining project boards and operational trackers

Updating CRM pipelines

Organizing workflow databases

Managing task management systems

Maintaining SOP libraries and operational documentation

Improving operational structure and workflow visibility

Tracking project statuses, invoices, sourcing updates, and client communication workflows

Creating organized internal systems that improve operational efficiency



Candidates MUST have advanced Notion experience.

Applicants without strong Notion experience will NOT be considered.



Estimating, Procurement & Invoice Coordination

Coordinate directly with the Cost Estimator to verify:

invoice details,

material quantities,

pricing accuracy,

product specifications,

and scope confirmations.

Assist with estimate preparation support and documentation organization.

Track outstanding invoices and follow up with clients regarding payments.



Coordinate communication between:

estimating,

procurement,

sourcing,

and delivery teams.

Help ensure smooth project transitions from sales to sourcing and delivery.



Google Drive & File Organization



Organize and maintain all Google Shared Drives and project folders.

Conduct regular cleanup and restructuring of operational files.

Ensure all documentation is properly named, filed, archived, and accessible.



Maintain organized digital systems across:

proposals,

estimates,

invoices,

contracts,

material documentation,

and client communication records.



Daily Workflow Expectations

The Executive Coordinator will communicate directly with management throughout the day and must be capable of operating proactively and independently.



Daily responsibilities include:

Reviewing all incoming client communications

Updating Notion dashboards and operational boards

Tracking pending action items

Monitoring project progress

Listening to business calls and documenting follow-up tasks

Coordinating with estimators and sourcing teams

Sending client follow-up
s within 24 hours

Managing invoice tracking and documentation

Organizing Google Shared Drives

Maintaining workflow accountability and operational organization



This role requires someone who is highly responsive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple moving parts simultaneously.



Required Skills & Qualifications

REQUIRED

3–5+ years of experience in:

Executive Assistance,

Operations Coordination,

Project Coordination,

Construction Administration,

or Business Operations Support.

Advanced Notion experience

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Strong organizational and multitasking skills

Experience managing operational workflows and systems

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Experience with:

Google Workspace,

Google Shared Drives,

Microsoft Office,

PDF editing,

and document organization.

Strong follow-through and accountability



HIGHLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Construction administration

Estimating coordination

Building materials or procurement

Product sourcing

Vendor coordination

Real estate development support

QuickBooks, Xero, or invoicing platforms

U.S.-based construction or service businesses

The ideal candidate is:

operationally minded,

systems-oriented,

proactive,

highly organized,

and extremely detail-focused.

This person should be capable of:

improving workflows,

identifying missing information,

maintaining operational structure,

and ensuring projects, communications, invoices, and client follow-ups remain organized and moving forward.

,

phone,

and Notion.

sustainability review,

construction management,

value engineering,

Low sales rank

Job Overview:



The Service Delivery Manager is the senior operational leader accountable for the end-to-end Service Delivery System – delivery, quality, and profitability – of itGenius’s client facing Managed Services IT. 



The role owns service excellence across all aspects of customer service delivery including helpdesk, technical delivery, project management and any other team that delivers customer facing value. 



It requires an executive who demonstrates extreme ownership, resourcefulness, initiative and proactivity – spotting service gaps, risks and system improvements then taking action on them within delegated authority.  





Core Accountabilities:

The Service Delivery Manager is held accountable for the following specific, measurable accountabilities, delegated from the CEO’s Exceptional Customer Value and Organizational Effectiveness accountabilities:



- Exceptional Service Delivery and Customer Satisfaction: Ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality, responsive IT services that result in outstanding customer value, satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy.



- Operational Efficiency and Scalability of Service: Optimize service delivery processes, systems, and team structures to achieve maximum operational efficiency and enable scalable growth across all service offerings.



- Service Innovation and AI Integration: Drive the strategic integration of AI and automation into service delivery workflows to enhance productivity, reduce errors, and improve the customer experience.



- Service Team Performance and Development: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global service delivery team that consistently meets performance targets and embodies the company’s values.





Key Responsibilities:



1. Ownership of Service Delivery

Hold end-to-end accountability for the performance of service delivery across all functions: Service Desk, Escalations, MSP, and Projects.

Continuously improve, drive initiatives and self-source tasks from customer data, tickets, trends, and team behaviour. Do not operate as a task-taker – you are a task maker.

Take extreme ownership. It’s its customer facing, its your problem. Own the outcome and coordinate the fix.

Be the senior point of escalation for any service issue that risks client churn, SLA breach, or reputation damage, and close the loop personally.

Attend and actively contribute to the leaders standups, retrospectives and executive meetings. Present findings & insights, not status updates.

Own a quarterly systems improvement programme to constantly drive service excellence.



2. QA, Proactive Risk Management and Client Retention

Own the relationship between CSAT, NPS, FCR, SLA adherence, and client retention.

Run an independent quality assurance function across all aspects of customer service. Right people, right process, right tools, clear reporting.

Proactively address customer churn risk through regular spot checks, ‘walking the floor’ and searching for ‘smoke’ – finding risks before them become issues – harnessing our advanced tech platforms and AI tools to give you a deep level of insight while connecting with the humans to get the real story.

Take personal accountability for top accounts. Build relationships and keep your eye on them.

Build a direct, unmediated sense of the customer journey so you can pin point where problem might occur and work to solve them.

Prioritise customer relationships but never loose sight of the data. Stay in constant touch with shifts in customer satisfaction, sentiment, ticket volumes and team capacity.

Conduct and document monthly service reviews & executive level reporting.



3. Escalations and Critical I
 Management

Own the Escalations system end to end. No escalation left behind, stale checks run weekly, and responses coordinated across Service Desk, Projects, and MSP.

Own critical i
, such as major customer complaints or churn events. See them through to conclusion, ensuring the learnings, performance notes & systems level improvements are discovered and actioned.

Ensure every escalation is reviewed after resolution for systemic improvement, not just closed.

Ensure clean, completed data on customer complaints for analysis. Data driven decision making to identify systems gaps & improvements.



4. System Fluency and Operational Discipline

Fervently adopt, own & promote use of our technology stack, including use of AI, operational system of record & ticketing platforms.

Hold the team accountable to tool use & excellent data integrity.

Keep your queues clean – inbox zero policy.

Establish automation (workflow and AI) where there’s a demonstrable ROI. Don’t exclude humans from the loop. We are AI first, but humans have the final say.

Own continuous improvement of internal process documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base entries.





5. Team Leadership and Collaboration

Lead, mentor, and develop Team Leaders across Service Desk, Escalations, and MSP. Build above-the-line behaviour, clear agreements, and collaborative problem-solving.

Cover the full span of service functions. Do not over-index on any single team.

Work with the Head of People, Culture and Operations to run structured performance conversations, including private feedback where required.

Partner with the Head of Growth to ensure seamless onboarding, service activation, and ongoing customer lifecycle value.

Partner with Finance to ensure service profitability and accurate billing tied to service delivery data.

Partner with the Head of People, Culture and Operations on staffing stability, role clarity, and team development.

Surface strategic insights, customer feedback themes, and service trend data to the Executive team with recommendations, not just observations.



Required Qualifications:

Executive Leadership and Operations

- 5+ years in a senior service delivery, operations, or Managed Services leadership role with direct accountability for client retention and service KPIs.

- Minimum 3+ years in Managed Services Provider (MSP) leadership or service delivery management, preferably with a recognised service framework such as ITIL.

- Proven track record of owning end-to-end service delivery at executive level, including multi-pod or multi-function oversight.

- Demonstrated experience designing and scaling service delivery processes in a remote-first or globally distributed team.

- Experience running quality assurance and spot-check programs, not just reporting dashboards.

- Hands-on system fluency with work management platform, ticketing systems such and documentation tools.

- Experience integrating AI and automation into support workflows is strongly preferred.

- Experience supporting small business clients (1 to 30 employees) preferred.

- Project Management: Demonstrated success managing multiple IT projects and service improvement initiatives. PMP certification preferred.



Technical Expertise

- Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.

- 10+ years in IT service delivery or technical support.

- Advanced certifications highly regarded: Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator or Engineer, Google Workspace Administrator, CCNP, or CompTIA Security+.

- Solid understanding of compliance frameworks, IT security practices, and i
 response processes.

- Demonstrated success in resolving complex, escalated technical issues across diverse environments with minimal supervision.

- Strong diagnostic, root cause analysis, and performance tuning skills to ensure reliability and scalability of IT systems.

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS), including migrations, hybrid integrations, and identity management are nice to have but not required.



Delegated Authority to Spend

Full-time, 8-hour shift, Monday to Friday, weekends off.

Applying technology to improve productivity and collaboration

Job Overview:



The Service Delivery Manager is the senior operational leader accountable for the end-to-end Service Delivery System – delivery, quality, and profitability – of itGenius’s client facing Managed Services IT. 



The role owns service excellence across all aspects of customer service delivery including helpdesk, technical delivery, project management and any other team that delivers customer facing value. 



It requires an executive who demonstrates extreme ownership, resourcefulness, initiative and proactivity – spotting service gaps, risks and system improvements then taking action on them within delegated authority.  





Core Accountabilities:

The Service Delivery Manager is held accountable for the following specific, measurable accountabilities, delegated from the CEO’s Exceptional Customer Value and Organizational Effectiveness accountabilities:



- Exceptional Service Delivery and Customer Satisfaction: Ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality, responsive IT services that result in outstanding customer value, satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy.



- Operational Efficiency and Scalability of Service: Optimize service delivery processes, systems, and team structures to achieve maximum operational efficiency and enable scalable growth across all service offerings.



- Service Innovation and AI Integration: Drive the strategic integration of AI and automation into service delivery workflows to enhance productivity, reduce errors, and improve the customer experience.



- Service Team Performance and Development: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global service delivery team that consistently meets performance targets and embodies the company’s values.





Key Responsibilities:



1. Ownership of Service Delivery

Hold end-to-end accountability for the performance of service delivery across all functions: Service Desk, Escalations, MSP, and Projects.

Continuously improve, drive initiatives and self-source tasks from customer data, tickets, trends, and team behaviour. Do not operate as a task-taker – you are a task maker.

Take extreme ownership. It’s its customer facing, its your problem. Own the outcome and coordinate the fix.

Be the senior point of escalation for any service issue that risks client churn, SLA breach, or reputation damage, and close the loop personally.

Attend and actively contribute to the leaders standups, retrospectives and executive meetings. Present findings & insights, not status updates.

Own a quarterly systems improvement programme to constantly drive service excellence.



2. QA, Proactive Risk Management and Client Retention

Own the relationship between CSAT, NPS, FCR, SLA adherence, and client retention.

Run an independent quality assurance function across all aspects of customer service. Right people, right process, right tools, clear reporting.

Proactively address customer churn risk through regular spot checks, ‘walking the floor’ and searching for ‘smoke’ – finding risks before them become issues – harnessing our advanced tech platforms and AI tools to give you a deep level of insight while connecting with the humans to get the real story.

Take personal accountability for top accounts. Build relationships and keep your eye on them.

Build a direct, unmediated sense of the customer journey so you can pin point where problem might occur and work to solve them.

Prioritise customer relationships but never loose sight of the data. Stay in constant touch with shifts in customer satisfaction, sentiment, ticket volumes and team capacity.

Conduct and document monthly service reviews & executive level reporting.



3. Escalations and Critical I
 Management

Own the Escalations system end to end. No escalation left behind, stale checks run weekly, and responses coordinated across Service Desk, Projects, and MSP.

Own critical i
, such as major customer complaints or churn events. See them through to conclusion, ensuring the learnings, performance notes & systems level improvements are discovered and actioned.

Ensure every escalation is reviewed after resolution for systemic improvement, not just closed.

Ensure clean, completed data on customer complaints for analysis. Data driven decision making to identify systems gaps & improvements.



4. System Fluency and Operational Discipline

Fervently adopt, own & promote use of our technology stack, including use of AI, operational system of record & ticketing platforms.

Hold the team accountable to tool use & excellent data integrity.

Keep your queues clean – inbox zero policy.

Establish automation (workflow and AI) where there’s a demonstrable ROI. Don’t exclude humans from the loop. We are AI first, but humans have the final say.

Own continuous improvement of internal process documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base entries.





5. Team Leadership and Collaboration

Lead, mentor, and develop Team Leaders across Service Desk, Escalations, and MSP. Build above-the-line behaviour, clear agreements, and collaborative problem-solving.

Cover the full span of service functions. Do not over-index on any single team.

Work with the Head of People, Culture and Operations to run structured performance conversations, including private feedback where required.

Partner with the Head of Growth to ensure seamless onboarding, service activation, and ongoing customer lifecycle value.

Partner with Finance to ensure service profitability and accurate billing tied to service delivery data.

Partner with the Head of People, Culture and Operations on staffing stability, role clarity, and team development.

Surface strategic insights, customer feedback themes, and service trend data to the Executive team with recommendations, not just observations.



Required Qualifications:

Executive Leadership and Operations

- 5+ years in a senior service delivery, operations, or Managed Services leadership role with direct accountability for client retention and service KPIs.

- Minimum 3+ years in Managed Services Provider (MSP) leadership or service delivery management, preferably with a recognised service framework such as ITIL.

- Proven track record of owning end-to-end service delivery at executive level, including multi-pod or multi-function oversight.

- Demonstrated experience designing and scaling service delivery processes in a remote-first or globally distributed team.

- Experience running quality assurance and spot-check programs, not just reporting dashboards.

- Hands-on system fluency with work management platform, ticketing systems such and documentation tools.

- Experience integrating AI and automation into support workflows is strongly preferred.

- Experience supporting small business clients (1 to 30 employees) preferred.

- Project Management: Demonstrated success managing multiple IT projects and service improvement initiatives. PMP certification preferred.



Technical Expertise

- Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field.

- 10+ years in IT service delivery or technical support.

- Advanced certifications highly regarded: Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator or Engineer, Google Workspace Administrator, CCNP, or CompTIA Security+.

- Solid understanding of compliance frameworks, IT security practices, and i
 response processes.

- Demonstrated success in resolving complex, escalated technical issues across diverse environments with minimal supervision.

- Strong diagnostic, root cause analysis, and performance tuning skills to ensure reliability and scalability of IT systems.

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS), including migrations, hybrid integrations, and identity management are nice to have but not required.



Delegated Authority to Spend

- Annually budgeted spend for service delivery tools, training, and team incentives.

- All other expenses require CEO approval.

 



Work Schedule

Full-time, 8-hour shift, Monday to Friday, weekends off.

Shift timing aligned to Australian business hours where client coverage requires.

Public holiday observance per the candidate’s country of engagement (Philippines, South Africa, or Malaysia)





You’ll thrive here if you’re interested in:

The evolving world of cloud-based work (Google Workspace, Google Drive, Gmail, etc.)

Supporting small business growth (1–30 employees)

Applying technology to improve productivity and collaboration

I run three companies from Brooklyn, New York: an AI software company, a hospitality SaaS, and a lifestyle/publishing brand. I am hiring one senior Executive VA to become my right hand on operations, communication, and follow-through.

This is not a task-rabbit role. You will own real responsibility from week one and grow with the company. The right person stays for years and grows into team leadership as we hire additional staff.

Inbox management — Triage all incoming
 daily, draft responses for my review, flag the urgent, file the rest. Keep my inbox under 20 messages.

Calendar management — Schedule meetings, defend deep-work blocks, send confirmations and reminders, handle rescheduling.

Light CRM — Maintain a contact database, segment by relationship type, log all interactions and follow-ups.

Document organization — Keep Google Drive organized, file documents consistently, build a clean folder structure that other team members can navigate.

Follow-through tracking — When I commit to something in a meeting or message, you track it and remind me until it's done.

Light bookkeeping support — Categorize transactions in Stripe and Mercury, prepare files for the monthly bookkeeper.

Meeting prep — Pull background on people I'm meeting with, prepare one-page briefings.

Transcription cleanup — I will record voice memos and meetings. You will clean up transcripts and file them in the right project folders.

Vendor and contractor coordination — Schedule with my designer, lawyer, accountant, and other contract help.





Required Skills



3+ years experience supporting a U.S.-based founder, executive, or small-business owner. Please name them in your application.

Excellent written English. I will be testing this in the application — see below.

Confident with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).

Working knowledge of at least one of: Notion, Airtable, ClickUp, or Asana.

Comfortable with Stripe (reading transactions, basic understanding of subscriptions), or willing to learn fast.

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, working webcam.

Available during 9 AM – 1 PM U.S. Eastern Time daily.





Nice to Have



Experience with hospitality, real estate, creative-industry, or AI/tech founders

Light bookkeeping or accounting background

Basic Canva or visual organization skills

Familiarity with Otter.ai, Loom, or transcription tools





What I Offer



$800–1,200 USD/month starting pay, based on experience, paid weekly via Wise

Performance review at 90 days with raise eligibility

13th-month pay

Paid holidays (you choose 10 per year, including your local holidays)

5 days paid sick leave per year, growing with tenure

Long-term stability — hiring for years, not months

Growth path — as my team grows, you have first opportunity to manage new hires

Direct working relationship with me, the founder





How to Apply

I read every application. Generic copy-paste applications will be rejected automatically. To apply, send me a message with the following, in this order:



The word "Brownstone" as the first word of your message

Your name, location, and current work situation

Three sentences on the U.S. founder or executive you have most recently supported, and what you owned for them

One example of a time you caught a mistake or prevented a problem before your employer noticed it

Your monthly rate expectation

Your availability to start

One question for me about the role



Applications that follow this format move to the next round. I will reply within 5 business days to those I want to interview.

Thank you for reading. I am excited to find the right person.

title: Creative Strategist / DTC Research VA — Long-Term Role with 2+ years experience
description:
About Us

We're a multi-brand DTC e-commerce company doing ~$200K/month. We run paid ads on Meta at scale and we're growing fast.

We're not an agency. We own our brands. That means when you write a winning ad, you see the spend scale, the ROAS climb, and the brand grow. Your work has real impact and you stay with us long-term.

We're hiring ONE Creative Strategist to work directly with the founder. This is a long-term role, not a project. If you want stability, growth, and to actually OWN the creative output of a real brand, keep reading.



What You'll Actually Do

You are the engine behind every ad we run. You research, you think, you write, and you brief our editors. The editors execute YOUR ideas. You will:



Write hooks, ad concepts, and short-form scripts (15s, 30s, 60s, and longer VSL formats)

Develop angles — new mechanisms, new avatars, new pain points, new positioning we haven't tested yet

Mine customer reviews, comments, and competitor ads to find winning insights and translate them into ads

Brief our video editors with clear, executable creative briefs (we'll teach you our brief format)

Analyze ad performance and tell us what to double down on, what to iterate, what to kill

Build creative variations from winners — take one winning ad and turn it into 10–20 meaningful variations

Research customer psychology using reviews from Amazon, Trustpilot, Reddit, and our own product pages

Manage the creative pipeline in Google Sheets / Notion (briefs, deadlines, asset tracking, performance)

Stay on top of competitor activity — what new ads are running, what offers are tested, what's scaling



The founder will work alongside you on strategy. But you own the creative output. If our ads suck, that's on you. If they win, that's on you too — and we pay accordingly.



Who This Is For

You are right for this role if:



You have at least 1 year of hands-on experience writing ads, hooks, and concepts for DTC or e-commerce brands. Not just "social media posts." Direct response paid ads.

You can show us ads you wrote that ran on Meta or TikTok with real spend behind them

You speak fluent written English and your writing has voice, rhythm, and persuasion — not robotic AI output

You're obsessed with customer psychology. You actually enjoy reading 100 reviews to find the one phrase that becomes the hook.

You're organized to a fault. Briefs go out on time, files named properly, sheets updated daily.

You can write FAST. A new hook in 10 minutes, not 2 hours. A full 30s script in 30 minutes.

You want to learn DTC marketing at a high level over 1–2 years and grow with one company.

You can work 30–40 hours/week consistently.



You are NOT right for this role if:



You're a graphic designer, video editor, or general VA looking to pivot. This is a writer + strategist role.

You write generic "benefit list" ads. We need angles, hooks, narratives — not bullet points.

You can't show real ads you wrote. Portfolio is mandatory.

You're using AI to write your application but couldn't defend your own answer live on a call.

You want to run 5 client gigs on the side. We need focus.





Compensation



Hourly: $5–8/hour depending on experience and portfolio strength

Hours: 30–40 hrs/week (full-time)

Schedule: Flexible. Some overlap with European hours required (5 hours/day minimum overlap).

Performance bonus: After 90 days, you earn a bonus every time one of your ads scales past a spend threshold at positive ROAS. Real money on top of base. We pay extra for winners.

Growth path: Strong performers move to $7–10/hour within 6 months and own a full brand inside the company within 12 months.



We pay on time. Every time. 



How to Apply (Read Carefully — Most Applicants Will Skip This)

We get a lot of AI-generated applications. We can spot them in 10 seconds and we delete them. Here's what we actually want:

1. Put the word "octopus" as the first word of your application. This tells us you read the post.

2. Pick ONE ad from Meta Ad Library (
.>
/ads/library) — any DTC brand, any niche. Then answer in your own words (NOT ChatGPT):



a) What is the hook in the first 3 seconds and why does it work?

b) Who is the target customer (avatar) and what is the main pain point or desire being triggered?

c) Write 3 alternate hooks you would test against this ad. Real hooks, written out as you would write them for a script.

d) What angle would you test next to improve performance (new avatar, new mechanism, new positioning)?



Keep it tight. 200–300 words total. We care about your THINKING and your WRITING, not the length.

3. Share your portfolio. Send 2–3 examples of ads, hooks, scripts, or concepts YOU wrote that ran for real brands. Drive link, Notion page, or PDF — whatever works. No portfolio = no interview.

4. Tell us:



Your hourly rate (within $5–8)

Your weekly availability (hours/week)

Your WhatsApp number

How many years you've specifically written ads, hooks, or scripts for paid social

Which brands or industries you've written for

One sentence: why this role specifically, not just "any job"





What Happens Next

If your application is strong, we send you ONE paid test brief — You write hooks, a script, and a short concept rationale. Pass that, and we book a 20-minute call.

After the call, we offer a 30-day paid trial at your hourly rate. After 30 days, we either commit long-term or part ways professionally.

We move fast. If we like you, you can be working within 1 week.



What We're NOT



Not an agency. You work with the founder directly.

Not a "job mill." We hire ONE person at a time and we keep them for years.

Not looking for graphic designers, video editors, or general VAs.



If this sounds like the right fit — apply today. We're reviewing applications this week and hiring fast.

This role also includes participation in an after-hours on-call rotation. During on-call shifts, you will receive calls related to caregiver call-outs, late arrivals, urgent staffing needs, and occasional inquiry calls. Reliability and responsiveness during these times are critical.



You will use systems such as WellSky, Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), and our scheduling software to manage communication and staffing operations.

rsonal Care, or similar systems

title: Video Editor
description:
ABOUT BRAINOVA AI

Brainova AI helps founders, operators, and decision-makers scale their companies with AI — AI agents, AI employees, workflow automation, and the practical playbooks behind it all. We're expanding into video as a primary distribution channel and hiring a Video Editor to anchor our content production.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a video editor who can turn our raw footage into LinkedIn-native videos, YouTube long-form, Shorts, and Reels. LinkedIn is our primary platform, so the cuts going there must be tuned for muted autoplay, burned-in captions, and a 1–2 second hook.



We're at the start of building out our video brand. There's no locked-in show format, style guide, or template library yet — you'll help us design it. We need a partner with strong opinions, not just a button-pusher. If you only want to execute against a finished brief, this isn't the right role.



Reference style: Alex Hormozi and Dan Martell — retention-engineered long-form (constant on-screen text, b-roll punch-ins, pattern interrupts) and hook-driven vertical edits.



Tone: Smart but not stuffy. Confident, fast, occasionally funny. We sell people a dream and show them how to achieve it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit long-form YouTube episodes (8–30 min) with cold-opens, chapters, b-roll, animated captions, lower-thirds, music, and sound design

- Edit LinkedIn-native videos (30–90 sec, 1:1 or 4:5, burned-in captions, scroll-stopping hooks)

- Edit vertical Shorts/Reels/TikToks (15–60 sec, 9:16) with strong 3-second hooks

- Multi-cam syncing for podcast and talking-head shoots

- Repurpose long-form into standalone clips, each with its own hook and payoff

- Add b-roll, motion graphics, animated captions, transitions, SFX, and music

- Color correct and grade for series consistency

- Dialogue cleanup, leveling, noise reduction, LUFS-aware mastering

- Design and produce thumbnails and cover images for each piece (LinkedIn + YouTube)

- Help define the show: visual style, format, template library, workflow, naming conventions



MUST HAVE

- 2+ years editing for YouTube, podcasts, or social — with a public portfolio showing both long-form and Shorts

- Fluent in at least one pro NLE: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Working competence in After Effects (or Fusion) for motion graphics and animated text

- Strong audio chops: leveling, noise reduction, de-essing, music ducking (Audition, Fairlight, or Logic)

- Captioning workflow you can run end-to-end (Descript, CapCut, Premiere auto-transcribe, etc.) with brand styling

- Fluency with AI-powered video editing and content generation tools (Descript, Runway, CapCut AI, Opus Clip, Submagic, ElevenLabs, Sora, Veo, Kling, etc.) AND genuine openness to learn new ones as they emerge. The AI video space moves fast — we want someone who actively explores tools that streamline production and raises the quality ceiling, not someone who only sticks to what they learned three years ago

- Native-level English comprehension — you can spot the right pull-quote in a 90-min conversation and know where a joke lands

- Reliable delivery, sensible file naming, and consistent communication

- Comfortable with ambiguity — the first few weeks will involve a lot of "let's try it and see"



NICE TO HAVE

- LinkedIn-native video experience (muted autoplay, 1–2 sec hooks, square/portrait-first)

- Hormozi/MrBeast/direct-response editing style

- Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Figma)

- Familiarity with YouTube analytics — retention curves, average view duration



HOW WE'LL WORK

- Async-first, with a few working sessions per week at the start while we define the show, then lighter check-ins once a style is locked

- Project-based pay to start — we may begin anywhere from ~10 hours a week up to full-time right away, depending on fit

- Long-term role for the right person; you'll co-own the Brainova AI video style guide

- 
 or similar for review; Google Drive / Dropbox for assets



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following — applications missing any of these will be skipped:



1. PORTFOLIO: Links to 2–3 long-form edits and 2–3 Shorts/Reels you cut. For each one, tell us what YOU specifically did vs. what the client provided.



2. TOOLS: The NLE, motion graphics, and audio software you use day-to-day — plus any AI video tools you currently use in your workflow and what you use them for.



3. RATE: Per short, per long-form, per hour, and/or per month. Be specific.



4. AVAILABILITY: Hours per week and your time zone.



5. SHOW YOUR BUILD CHOPS: One example of a channel or brand whose visual style you helped shape from scratch (or significantly evolved). What did you choose, and why? Link to before/after if you have it.



6. To prove you actually read this post, start your message with the word "SHIPPED" in all caps. Messages without it will be ignored.



Shortlisted candidates will be sent a 5-minute raw clip to cut into a 30–60 second Short as a paid test edit.



We're looking forward to seeing your work.



— The Brainova AI Team

description:
Check out our brands before you apply:

BOSS Decks — 



Warm leads only. No cold calling.



Every person you will call has already asked us to contact them. Your job is simple: call them quickly, ask a few questions, and book them onto our US sales team's calendar.





About us

We are Rapid Home Service Group — one of the fastest-growing home improvement companies on Long Island, New York. We have two brands: Rapid Roofing (recognized by INC 5000 as the #30 fastest-growing construction company in America) and BOSS Decks (a certified TrexPro Gold installer).



Every day, homeowners reach out to us asking about roofing or deck projects. They come in by phone, text, web forms, Google Business Profile,
 Messenger, and Instagram DMs. Our goal: call every one of them within 5 minutes.





Why this job exists

In our business, the company that calls back the fastest wins. Most home improvement companies are slow. We refuse to be. You are the speed — the first person every customer talks to, the reason they feel taken care of from the very first call.



You will work from home, but you will not be alone. You will have daily check-ins with our team in the US, direct contact with the salespeople you are booking for, and clear daily targets so you always know if you are winning.





What you will do

- Call every new inbound lead within 5 minutes

- Ask a few simple questions to check if they are a good fit (project type, timeline, location)

- Book the right ones into our sales team's calendar in GoHighLevel (our CRM)

- Follow up with prospects on behalf of the sales team — confirmations, reminders, post-appointment touchpoints, and re-engagement of leads who have not yet booked

- Re-engage older leads with friendly check-in messages

- Send confirmation messages and reminders before appointments

- Keep the CRM clean and organized — every lead tagged, every follow-up scheduled

- Send review and referral requests after projects are completed



This is not a cold-calling job. Not a sales job. Not a script-reading job. The energy is closer to a great hotel front desk than a typical call center — warm, calm, friendly, and organized.





The bigger opportunity

We are not hiring one person and stopping there. We are building a full inbound call center to support our growing US operations. The people we hire first are the people we promote first. If you come in, perform well on the phones, and show us you can lead — you are in the running for team lead, trainer, and call center manager roles as we grow. We promote from within.





What we are looking for

- Excellent spoken English — clear, warm, and confident on the phone with American customers

- 2+ years of experience in an inbound call center, BPO, appointment setting, customer service, or front desk role

- Strong CRM skills — comfortable typing, tagging, and updating records all day

- Reliable home office: strong and stable high-speed internet, a quiet room, a good headset, and a backup power source (UPS or generator)

- Able to work US Eastern Time business hours — this means 9 PM to 7 AM Philippine time (graveyard shift). You must be available some Saturdays as well.

- Self-managing — we do not screen-record your bathroom breaks. The numbers tell us if you are doing well.

- Hungry for more — we want people who see this as a starting point, not a ceiling





Compensation

Strong performers in this role earn approximately PHP 2,400,000 per year — including base hourly pay plus performance bonuses. This is well above the average appointment setter pay in the Philippines because we pay for top performance and because we are building toward a multi-location call center where the best people here become the future leaders. The better you perform, the faster the pay grows.





How to apply



Send a resume and a video introducing yourself. This is the first step — applications without a video will not be reviewed. 



In your video, tell us:



1. Who you are — name, where you are based in the Philippines, and a quick introduction

2. Why you would be a great fit for this role — what makes you the right person for the job

3. Your relevant experience — call center, BPO, appointment setting, customer service, or any phone-based role you have done 

4. Confirm you are available to work 9 PM to 7 AM Philippine time, including some Saturdays

5. Answer this question in your own words: What is the difference between good customer service and great customer service?



If you are a fit, we will respond within 24 hours.



Start immediately.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:





[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Life & Habit Coach | Help People Reach Meaningful Goals
description:
We're a growing productivity coaching app helping people build better habits and reach their goals. We're looking for empathetic, consistent people who genuinely want to help others grow.



Who thrives here: People who are naturally easy to talk to, who notice things others miss, and who genuinely enjoy other people.

(Productivity expertise is teachable, warmth and social intuition aren't, so we hire for those.)



Your role:



Build a real, ongoing relationship with each client through daily conversation: written and occasional video calls when real-time matters.

Read between the lines- notice shifts in tone, ask the right follow-up, know when to push and when to listen. Keep clients accountable and adjust the plan when life happens.





What you'll be part of:

- A team that believes in real human coaching. We don't use AI to coach our clients, and we don't want it used in your application or training either. Human connection is the product.

- 15+ coaches who genuinely care about helping people grow

- Weekly team calls where coaches share strategies and learn together

- Monthly 20-minute reads on coaching and personal development, discussed as a team

- A culture of sharing a bit of who you are- a casual photo or quick life update to build connection with clients (low-key and natural, not too personal)

- Regular feedback on your coaching to help you keep growing





Schedule:

- You choose your 3-hour working block (pick a time and stick to it)

- Daily check-ins include weekends (lighter workload on weekends)

- Consistency is key (clients rely on hearing from you at roughly the same time each day)



The commitment:

This is a long-term role, not a casual freelance gig. We're looking for people who want to stick around and grow with us.

If you enjoy connecting with people and helping them grow, we'd love to hear from you.





Our hiring process:

1. Pre-screening

2. quiz

3. live interview.





PRE-SCREENING questions:

Send your replies as a message here.



Replies using AI will be discarded. We're screening for personality.



1. Alex, a developer, writes to you:

"I'm overwhelmed with client projects, marketing, social media… I get sidetracked easily, and by the time I deal with
s, it's too late for my core work. Staying motivated is getting tough."

How would you reply?





2. Sam has been checking in with you daily for two weeks and making good progress. Then he goes silent for 3 days — no check-ins, no messages.

What do you do?





3. Do you have a reliable computer (no phones or tablets) and internet connection? What's your backup plan for those?





4. What's are your preferred 3-hour work blocks in UTC?





5. Daily check-ins at the same time every day (including weekends- lighter workload) and a 10-day training program (1.5–2 hrs/day) are both required. Can you commit to both?





6. Send a short video introduction. This helps us understand your communication style and how you naturally guide others.



What to include (1–2 minutes max):

- A brief intro (your name, background, and what you're currently doing)

- What interested you on this position



This video doesn’t need to be polished or edited- we want to see the real you.

Submit via Loom (free) or as an unlisted YouTube and send the link in this chat.





Thank you and looking forward to your answers!

title: Care Specialist
description:
We are looking to hire immediately. This job posting will only be available for the next 24 hours. All applicants must complete take home assignment before 12PM Eastern Time. See here for the take home assignment: 



Interviews will be scheduled for Thursday afternoon Pacific Time. 



We're a fast-moving healthcare operations team that handles prior authorizations (PAs) for infusion clinic. We're building a team of sharp, hungry operators to help us do it at scale.



As a Care Specialist, you'll be on the front lines — initiating PA requests, verifying insurance benefits, navigating payer portals and phone systems, and documenting cases accurately in our internal platform. You'll work directly with our team leads and report into operations leadership.



Warning: this is not an easy job. The learning curve is steep and the pace is fast— every case you touch is a patient waiting on treatment. We'll train you on the content, but we can't train work ethic, attention to detail, or the drive to push through hard problems. If you want comfortable, this isn't it. If you want growth, you’ll fit right in. 



What You'll Do

Initiate prior authorization requests with insurance payers via online portals and phone calls

Accurately document case details, call notes, and outcomes in our internal case management platform

Navigate complex payer phone trees and hold times without losing steam

Identify when cases hit non-standard situations and escalate or problem-solve proactively

Follow SOPs closely while flagging gaps or process improvement opportunities

Manage a live queue of cases across multiple statuses — nothing falls through the cracks



You're a Great Fit If You Are...

Hungry and self-driven

You don't wait to be told what to do next — you find the next task

You want to grow fast and take on more responsibility over time



Obsessively detail-oriented

You catch errors others miss - wrong codes, missing fields, inconsistent info

You don't submit work you're not sure about

You understand that one mistake in a PA form can delay a patient's treatment by weeks 



A fast, independent learner

You can read a new SOP and execute it correctly within a few days 

You ask smart clarifying questions before going down the wrong path

You're comfortable not knowing everything on day one and excited to learn



A creative problem-solver

When a case hits an edge case, you think before you escalate

You come to your manager with a proposed solution, not just a problem

You document what happened so the next person doesn't hit the same wall



Resilient and relentless

Hold times, rejections, and ambiguous situations don't demoralize you

You stay focused through repetitive tasks without cutting corners

Requirements

Strong written and spoken English - you'll communicate with US insurance reps and clinic staff

Comfortable working US business hours (EST or PST overlap required)

Tech-comfortable — you can navigate multiple browser tabs, portals, and spreadsheets simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

What You Don't Need

A medical or clinical background — we'll teach you what you need to know about PAs and insurance. You just need to be a fast learner. 

Years of experience — we care far more about how you think and how hard you work



What We Offer

Above-market starting pay — we pay more than most entry-level BPO or VA roles because we expect more

Performance bonuses — hit your targets, earn more. Hustle is rewarded directly

Formal 4-month review — we evaluate and adjust compensation fast, not on a yearly corporate clock

Solid career growth path — PA Agent ? Senior PA Agent ? Team Lead. We promote from within and we're growing very fast 

Ground-floor opportunity — you're joining early. The people who build with us now are the ones who lead later

Fully Remote

title: LAMP Stack Developer

You will be responsible for managing the entire web development lifecycle, from server-side logic and database design to front-end implementation. Database Management: Architect and optimize MySQL databases, including schema design, indexing strategies, and writing high-performance queries.

Automation: Write and maintain shell scripts (Bash) to automate routine maintenance, system operations, and deployment workflows.



Front-End Integration: Develop interactive and responsive user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, leveraging jQuery and Bootstrap for a seamless user experience.



Code Quality: Write clean, documented, and maintainable code while performing thorough debugging and performance tuning.



Collaboration: Use Git for version control and collaborate with team members to ensure security best practices and architectural consistency.



Technical Qualifications

Linux: Proficiency in command-line environments, SSH, and server management.

Apache: Experience configuring and maintaining web server environments.

MySQL: Expert-level knowledge of relational database design, optimization, and complex querying.

Front-End & Tooling

Modern Web Tech: Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design (Bootstrap).

[removed] Proficiency in vanilla JS (DOM/Event handling) and jQuery/jQuery UI.

DevOps/Scripting: Experience with Bash/Shell scripting for system automation.

Bonus Points (Nice to Have)

Experience with modern PHP frameworks like Laravel.

Familiarity with RESTful API design and integration.

Knowledge of Nginx configuration.

title: Production Manager
description:
What You'll Own

Sourcing & Vendor Management



Identify, vet, and onboard suppliers across apparel, headwear, and accessories categories — domestic and overseas (primarily China, Vietnam, Pakistan, Bangladesh).

Build and maintain a tiered vendor scorecard: pricing, MOQs, lead times, quality, communication, licensing experience, and capacity.

Negotiate pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and tooling/setup fees. Push for terms that protect cash and reduce risk on new programs.

Maintain redundancy — at least two qualified vendors per major category to avoid single-source exposure.



Product Development & Sampling



Translate design briefs and tech packs into producible samples. Manage sample rounds (proto, SMS, PP, TOP) with clear approval gates.

Source trims, hardware, fabrics, and packaging. Build BOMs and maintain accurate component-level costing.

Coordinate with the founder and designers on color, fit, and construction feedback. Drive samples to commercial-ready in the minimum number of rounds.

Build and maintain tech packs, spec sheets, and a centralized product library (Notion, Google Drive, or equivalent).



Costing & Margin



Build landed cost models for every SKU: FOB, freight, duty, royalty, 3PL/FBA inbound, and packaging. Flag programs that don't hit margin targets early.

Track cost movements (raw materials, freight, FX) and renegotiate when conditions change.

Own COGS accuracy — what we think a unit costs vs. what it actually costs landed.



Licensing & Compliance



Manage submissions and approvals with CLC, ASU, Realtree, and future licensors. Track approval status across art, prototype, and pre-production stages.

Ensure all production runs comply with licensor requirements: approved art files, hangtags, labels, royalty reporting, and audit-ready documentation.

Maintain a clean paper trail — licensor approvals, vendor agreements, NDAs, and compliance certifications (CPSIA, Prop 65 where applicable).



Production & Delivery



Issue POs, manage production calendars, and hold vendors accountable to ship dates.

Coordinate inspections (in-line and final) with third-party QC firms or our own protocols. Define AQL standards by category and enforce them.

Manage freight forwarders, customs brokers, and 3PL/FBA inbound logistics. Optimize between air, sea, and LCL/FCL based on margin and timing.

Own the production tracker — every SKU, every PO, every milestone, visible at a glance.



Quality Control



Define QC checklists by product category. Build a defect taxonomy and track defect rates by vendor over time.

Manage RMAs, claims, and remediation when product arrives out of spec. Recover value from vendor errors — don't eat costs we didn't cause.

Customer satisfaction

title: YouTube Video Editor — Real Estate Investing Channel (Humphrey Yang / Graham Stephan style)
description:
About the channel



Brick by Brick Wealth is a YouTube channel hosted by Zach Garcia, focused on helping everyday people build real wealth — investing, business, money habits, and the path from middle-class to financially free. The editing style is modeled after creators like Humphrey Yang, Graham Stephan, George Kamel, and Vincent Chan: fast-paced, visually dynamic, packed with B-roll, on-screen text, charts, and motion graphics that make finance content engaging and rewatchable.

We're building this channel for the long term. We want one editor who learns our style, gets faster every month, and grows with us.



The role

You'll take raw long-form footage (talking head + screen recordings) and turn it into polished YouTube videos that hold viewer attention from start to finish. Videos range from 6-15 minutes. We'll publish 2-4 videos per month.

You'll work from a script + raw footage. We'll provide style references, brand assets, and a folder with everything you need.



What you'll do



Edit long-form YouTube videos in a fast-paced, retention-focused style

Cut on every beat — no dead air, no slow openings

Add B-roll, stock footage, and screen recordings to support every key point

Create on-screen text callouts, lower thirds, and animated text reveals

Build motion graphics: animated charts, numbers counting up, comparison visuals, dynamic infographics

Source royalty-free B-roll, stock images, and music that fit each video's topic

Color grade for a clean, modern, high-contrast look

Sound design: clean audio, music ducking under voiceover, subtle SFX on cuts and text reveals

Burn in captions

Design the hook — the first 5-10 seconds are the most important part of every video





Required skills



2+ years editing YouTube long-form content

Expert in Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve

Proficient in After Effects for motion graphics

Strong sense of pacing — you understand why Humphrey Yang's cuts hit and why most YouTubers' don't

Excellent English comprehension

Sound design instincts

Reliable internet and a machine that can handle 4K editing





Bonus skills



Background in personal finance or business content

Familiar with YouTube analytics and retention curves

Efficient at sourcing stock footage (Storyblocks, Artgrid, Envato)

Thumbnail design experience





Compensation

Per-video rate. Pay rate discussed with shortlisted candidates based on experience and sample work.

Pays on time, every time. Performance-based raises every 3-6 months based on quality, speed, and ownership.



How to apply

To filter out auto-applications, please do all three of the following — applications missing any of these will be ignored:



Subject line must start with: "BRICK BY BRICK — [Your Name]"

Send links to your 2-3 best YouTube edits. Bonus if any are personal finance, business, or educational content. If you do not have a portfolio or examples of work, you will not be considered.



Answer these 3 questions in your application:



Which YouTube finance/business creator's editing style do you study most, and what specifically do you try to learn from them?

What's your typical turnaround time for a 10-minute polished YouTube video from raw footage + script?

What editing software and machine do you use? (CapCut editors will not be considered)



Applications without all three will be deleted unread.



We'll review submissions, shortlist the top editors, and invite finalists to complete a short paid test edit.
