title: Finance Application Manager – Home Improvement Lending Position Overview
description:
Finance Application Manager / Home Improvement Loan Manager

Unsecured Consumer Financing | Contractor Point-of-Sale Finance | Home Improvement Lending

Role Summary: We are seeking a highly experienced Finance Application Manager / Home Improvement Loan Manager to own the full customer financing process for a home improvement company. This person must be an expert in unsecured consumer financing, contractor/dealer finance portals, loan applications, approvals, stipulations, funding conditions, dealer fees, and sales-team financing support across platforms such as Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua Finance, Home Run Financing, Equity Loan Network, GreenSky, EnerBank/Regions, Mosaic, Synchrony, Foundation Finance, PowerPay, and other home improvement financing providers.



POSITION SNAPSHOT



Reports To

Owner, General Manager, VP Sales, or Director of Operations



Employment Type

Full-time; in-office, hybrid, or remote depending on company needs



Primary Focus

Unsecured financing approvals, lender management, funding, sales support, and financing operations



Industry

Home Improvement, Remodeling, Energy Efficiency, Roofing, Solar, HVAC, Windows, Bath, Kitchen



Project Categories

Roofing, solar, HVAC, windows, doors, insulation, exterior paint, bathroom, kitchen, ADU, landscaping, and general remodeling





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the complete customer financing workflow from initial credit discussion through application submission, approval, document signing, project completion, funding, and lender follow-up.



Submit, monitor, and manage financing applications through lender portals including Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua Finance, Home Run Financing, Equity Loan Network, GreenSky, EnerBank/Regions, Mosaic, Synchrony, Foundation Finance, PowerPay, and other relevant providers.



Match each homeowner with the most suitable financing option based on credit profile, project type, loan amount, approval probability, monthly payment target, promotional product, lender rules, dealer fee, and company margin.



Handle unsecured loan applications, promotional financing, same-as-cash products, deferred-interest plans, fixed APR installment loans, reduced APR plans, and lender-specific home improvement products.



Work directly with lenders to resolve stipulations, identity verification, income or employment verification, homeownership questions, title/property concerns, completion certificates, funding exceptions, and documentation gaps.



Support sales representatives during in-home or virtual sales presentations by explaining payment options, approval paths, lender requirements, financing limitations, and next steps in clear customer-friendly language.



Build and maintain a lender decision matrix that helps the sales team know which lender to use first, second, and third based on project type, credit profile, desired payment, and dealer fee sensitivity.



Track loan approvals, declines, pending applications, funding delays, rehash opportunities, cancellation risks, missing documents, dealer fees, chargebacks, and funded volume.



Coordinate with sales, operations, production, accounting, and customer service to ensure financing paperwork aligns with project contracts, change orders, completion milestones, and lender funding rules.



Maintain lender relationships, program sheets, approval guidelines, rate/dealer fee schedules, portal access, compliance documents, contractor requirements, and training materials.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Minimum 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in home improvement financing, consumer lending, contractor financing, dealer finance, or point-of-sale finance operations.



Direct experience with unsecured home improvement financing is required; experience with secured loans, PACE, home equity, or solar financing is a plus but not a replacement for unsecured lending expertise.



Strong working knowledge of lender platforms such as Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua Finance, Home Run Financing, Equity Loan Network, GreenSky, EnerBank/Regions, Mosaic, Synchrony, Foundation Finance, PowerPay, or comparable programs.



Proven ability to improve approval rates, reduce funding delays, lower application fallout, support sales closing, and protect company profitability from excessive dealer fees or incorrect financing product selection.



Understanding of credit tiers, co-applicant strategies where permitted, lender credit boxes, loan amount limits, promotional product rules, dealer fee structures, stipulations, completion documents, and funding conditions.



Experience supporting finance sales for roofing, solar, HVAC, windows, doors, bath, kitchen, insulation, exterior paint, or other remodeling/home performance projects.



SKILLS & COMPETENCIES



Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financing clearly to homeowners, sales teams, lenders, and internal operations staff.



High attention to detail; able to catch contract mismatches, incorrect lender products, missing signatures, inaccurate loan amounts, funding risks, and compliance issues before they cause delays.



Strong sales-support mindset with the ability to help reps structure payments ethically and effectively without overpromising or misrepresenting loan terms.



Comfortable working in CRMs, lender portals, spreadsheets, pipeline trackers, e-signature platforms, and project management systems.



Ability to build repeatable processes, train sales teams, document lender rules, create scripts, and standardize finance workflows for scale.



Professional judgment, confidentiality, urgency, and a strong understanding of customer trust in financial discussions.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Application-to-approval rate and approval-to-funded rate.

Average time from application submission to approval and from completion to funding.

Reduction in pending stipulations, missing documents, rework, funding exceptions, and cancelled finance deals.

Funded monthly volume, financed project revenue, and financing-supported close rate.

Dealer fee control, lender mix optimization, and profitability protection.

Sales-team adoption of correct financing process and lender selection guidelines.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Prior role as Finance Manager, Loan Manager, Dealer Finance Manager, Consumer Finance Manager, Sales Finance Manager, or Financing Operations Manager for a home improvement, solar, HVAC, roofing, window, or remodeling company.

Established relationships with lender representatives, underwriters, account managers, or dealer support teams.

Experience creating financing playbooks, lender comparison sheets, sales scripts, monthly payment calculators, approval dashboards, and funding trackers.

Knowledge of compliance expectations around consumer finance disclosures, promotional financing language, adverse action handling, customer consent, data privacy, and fair lending practices.



IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate is a financing operator who understands both lending and sales. They know how to get customers approved, how to move files through lender portals, how to communicate with homeowners professionally, how to support sales without creating compliance risk, and how to protect company margin while increasing financed revenue. This person should be proactive, organized, lender-savvy, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning the entire finance desk for a fast-moving home improvement business.



RECOMMENDED INTERVIEW SCREENING QUESTIONS

Which home improvement finance platforms have you personally used, and what volume did you manage through each?

Describe your process for choosing between Service Finance, GoodLeap, Aqua, GreenSky/EnerBank, or other lenders for a specific homeowner.

How do you handle a declined application, a conditional approval, or a funding hold?

How do dealer fees affect project pricing and lender selection?

What reports would you build to manage approval rate, funded volume, pending stipulations, and finance fallout?



COMPENSATION STRUCTURE

Recommended structure: competitive base salary plus performance bonus tied to funded volume, approval rate improvement, funding speed, reduced fallout, and sales-team finance adoption. Final compensation should reflect market, experience level, lender expertise, and size of financing pipeline.

title: Senior Property Manager
description:
About This Role

This is a career-level property management position — not a virtual assistant role.



Suites by VTJ is a property management company based in Raleigh, North Carolina. We manage a mixed portfolio of long-term residential, commercial, and short-term rental properties. Part of our tenant base communicates exclusively in Spanish, and we need a Senior Property Manager who can serve both English and Spanish-speaking tenants at the same professional standard.



You will be the operational decision-maker for the portfolio. The Junior Assistant Property Manager reports to you. The CEO trusts you to handle what requires judgment and expects to be involved only when it truly needs ownership-level input.



If you have real property management experience, a proven remote work track record, and the discipline to run a portfolio without daily supervision — this role was built for you.



What You Will Own

Lease Operations: Review and finalize all lease agreements, renewals, addenda, and amendments before they go out for signature. You are the last check — nothing with a legal implication leaves without your review. Coordinate DocuSign routing and confirm completion at every stage.



Tenant Relationship Management: Handle all escalated tenant communications — complaints, disputes, delinquency conversations, move-in and move-out coordination. Manage the full scope of Spanish-language tenant accounts without routing through the CEO. Respond to all tenant messages within the 2-hour standard during your shift.



Rent Collection Follow-Through: Ensure all late accounts have a documented touchpoint by the 3rd of every month without exception. Send reminders, issue late notices, document every step, and hand clean records to the accounting team. Conduct payment plan conversations with professionalism and firmness in both English and Spanish.



Maintenance Oversight and Vendor Management: Track every open maintenance ticket from report to confirmed resolution. Hold vendors accountable to their timelines. Verify insurance certificates and contract compliance. Update tenants proactively — no tenant should ever have to ask for a status update on an open ticket.



Junior APM Direction and Quality Control: Review the Junior APM's daily output before it reaches tenants. Catch errors, address them directly, and raise communication and documentation standards over time. Their performance is part of your accountability.



Compliance and Emergency Readiness: Keep all properties compliant with HOA rules, local policy, and vendor contract requirements. Maintain an up-to-date emergency contact and response protocol for each property so urgent after-hours situations have a clear first action.



Skills Required

Property Management Skills

- Lease administration: drafting, reviewing, and finalizing residential and commercial leases, addenda, and amendments

- Tenant communication and relationship management — English and Spanish

- Rent collection management: reminders, late notices, payment plans, and documentation

- Maintenance coordination: ticket tracking, vendor follow-up, insurance certificate verification

- Move-in and move-out coordination: inspections, key handoffs, deposit documentation

- Lease renewal management: proactive outreach, negotiation, and completion

- HOA compliance: routing notices, maintaining records, flagging violations

- Vacancy management: tour coordination, prospect communication, and conversion

- E-signature workflow management (DocuSign or equivalent)



Technical and Tool Skills

- Property Management Software: DoorLoop (preferred) or Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi, or equivalent — proficiency required

- Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Google Calendar — daily use

- Project Management: ClickUp or equivalent — task tracking and workflow management

- Communication: Slack for internal messaging, Ooma or VoIP for tenant and vendor calls

- Time Tracking: Hubstaff — used for remote accountability during shift hours

- Video Meetings: Google Meet for team check-ins and candidate interviews

- Document Design: Canva — basic tenant communication materials when needed



Soft Skills

- Extreme attention to detail: documents, dates, dollar amounts, and addenda — especially under time pressure

- Remote self-management: ability to run a full workday without a manager present, with proactive communication discipline

- Independent judgment: makes decisions at the portfolio level and escalates only what genuinely requires CEO input

- Professional written and verbal English: tenant notices, lease correspondence, and vendor communication

- Professional written and verbal Spanish: strongly preferred — formal tenant correspondence, complaints, and collections calls

- De-escalation: calm, firm, and solutions-oriented with difficult or upset tenants in both languages

- Team direction: raises the output quality of a junior tea
mber through direct, specific, non-punishing feedback

- Prioritization under pressure: manages multiple open items across multiple properties simultaneously without dropping details

- Ownership mindset: closes every loop, documents every touchpoint, and surfaces problems before they become visible to leadership



You Are the Right Fit If

- You have 3 or more years in property management, leasing, or real estate operations

- You have managed both residential and commercial properties — single-family-only experience is a gap for this portfolio

- You have worked fully remote before and can describe what your personal accountability system looks like

- You have directed or reviewed a junior tea
mber's work and corrected their output directly

- You write and speak Spanish at a professional level — formal correspondence, not just conversational

- Your home office is ready: 60 Mbps or faster, dual monitors, 16 GB+ RAM or Mac, dedicated headset, quiet private workspace



This Role Is Not For You If

- You need daily task lists to know what to prioritize

- You have only worked in-office or hybrid and have no fully-remote track record

- Difficult tenant conversations — in either language — make you uncomfortable

- Documentation is something you do when you remember, not as a first instinct



Home Office Requirements

Your setup is verified during the interview. Minimum standards:

 - Internet: 60 Mbps download or faster (screenshot required at application)

 - Monitors: Dual monitors

 - Computer: Modern multi-core CPU, 16 GB+ RAM, or Mac equivalent

 - Audio: Professional-grade headset — no laptop speakers or earbuds

 - Workspace: Private, quiet, and professional-looking on camera



Hiring Process

1. Application — Four knockout questions + internet speed screenshot. Incomplete applications are not reviewed.

2. Pre-Assessment — 45–60 minute written assessment sent to passing applicants only. Tests scenario judgment, written communication, remote work discipline, and personality fit.

3. Google Meet Interview — 45-minute structured behavioral interview with the CEO. Includes a live workspace verification. Bilingual candidates will be checked on Spanish during the call.

4. Reference Checks — Finalists arrange calls between the CEO and two former direct supervisors. This step is mandatory. We tell every candidate this at the start.

5. Offer — Extended to one finalist on the day the decision is made.



About Suites by VTJ

Suites by VTJ is a fast-moving, high-accountability property management company in Raleigh, NC. We manage a mixed portfolio and operate with a lean remote team that holds a high bar. The standard we hire to is the standard the business runs to.

title: Marketing & Content Specialist
description:

You will be the sole marketing person for a small, connected family of businesses based in Raleigh, North Carolina — a residential cleaning service, a property rental and management company, a personal brand, and a faith organization in pre-launch. One owner. Aligned values. Shared content infrastructure.



This is not a task-list job. No one will tell you what to post each day. You will own the content calendars, produce all the graphics and videos, write all the copy, manage the platforms, track the leads, and report the results — for all four brands — as a trusted independent contributor.



Before you close the tab: this is not as heavy as it sounds. Three brands are actively running; the fourth is a foundation project in the early months. Most weeks, the actual output is 2–3 posts per brand, a handful of creatives, and one monthly report. What it requires is someone who thrives on variety and owns their work without being chased.



THE BRAND FAMILY

Residential Cleaning Brand: Primary outcome: generating qualified cleaning inquiries through digital channels.

Property Management Brand: Short-term and long-term rentals.

Personal Brand (Owner / CEO): Thought leadership on business, operations, and entrepreneurship.

Faith Organization (Pre-Launch): Building the brand identity and content strategy from scratch. This is the lightest brand near-term..



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Content calendars for all active brands — planned and approved two weeks ahead, always

- All creatives produced in-house: static graphics, short-form video (Reels, Stories, promotional clips), thumbnails

- All copy: captions, listing descriptions, Google Business updates, and promotional content in each brand's distinct voice

- Google Business Profile management for the cleaning brand: posts, review responses, profile updates

- Lead tracking and tagging in GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM within 48 hours of receipt

-  Monthly performance report delivered by the 3rd of each month: reach, engagement, follower growth, and lead volume per brand

- AI tools used with judgment — you work faster with AI, but your editorial direction drives every output



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

?? 2–4 years in digital marketing or social media management — agency or multi-brand background strongly preferred

?? Portfolio required: at least 2 brands, at least 1 result metric (follower growth %, engagement rate, lead volume, bookings, or GMB impressions), and at least 1 video or Reel sample

?? Video editing (required, not optional): you produce finished short-form video from raw footage — CapCut, Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent

?? Graphic design in Canva or equivalent — consistent, on-brand output without needing a dedicated designer

?? Tools: Meta Business Suite, Google Business Profile, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM, and a scheduling tool

?? AI tools with judgment: you use them to work faster and produce more, not to replace your thinking; you can describe where your editorial judgment still has to lead

?? Professional-level written English — your copy goes live without editing from us

?? Night shift setup: 50+ Mbps internet, dedicated quiet workspace, backup connectivity, and equipment that supports the 9AM–6PM ET schedule



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

? You need a daily brief to know what to post

? You cannot edit video — portfolio shows no Reels, Stories, or short-form video samples

? The 9AM–6PM ET schedule (night shift) does not work for your life

? You are not comfortable creating content for a faith organization



HOW TO APPLY

Submit your application. You must complete all items — applications missing the portfolio link or Speedtest screenshot will not be reviewed.

Required attachments:

?? Portfolio link — must show work from at least 2 brands, at least 1 result metric, and at least 1 video or Reel sample

?? Speedtest screenshot — run a test at 
 or speedtest.net; minimum 50 Mbps download; screenshot must be current (taken within 7 days)



Application questions:

2. Describe a time you created content for two brands in the same week with completely different tones. How did you manage the switch, and what did each output look like?

3. Have you managed social media for a faith-based or mission-driven organization? If yes, describe it. If no, describe your approach to values-led brand voices.

title: Appointment Setter / Sales Setter
description:
Appointment Setter / Sales Setter

Product Manager Accelerator (PMA)

 Remote | Full-Time





Overview

Product Manager Accelerator (PMA) helps ambitious professionals break into product management, AI product management, and land opportunities at leading tech companies and startup unicorns. Founded by Dr. Nancy Li, a Forbes-featured product leader, PMA has helped professionals accelerate their careers through world-class coaching, training, and community.

We are one of the fastest-growing companies in the product management and AI career education space, and we are looking for a hungry, coachable, and high-energy Appointment Setter to join our sales team.

This role is ideal for someone who loves sales, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to grow in the high-ticket coaching and education industry.

Our programs range from $6,000 to $20,000, so this is not an entry-level admin role. This is a high-performance sales role for someone serious about learning, earning, and growing.



About the Role

As an Appointment Setter, your main responsibility is to start conversations with qualified leads, build trust, follow up consistently, handle early objections, and book high-quality calls for our closers.

You will be speaking with both warm leads from YouTube and other organic channels, as well as cold leads generated through paid ads.

You will engage prospects through channels such as Instagram, LinkedIn,
, SMS, and phone, and help move them toward booking a qualified sales call with our team.

This is a high-intensity, high-reward role. People who are hungry, resilient, coachable, competitive, and fast learners tend to do very well here.



Key Responsibilities

Reach out to and follow up with both warm leads from YouTube and organic channels and cold leads from paid ads

Start conversations with prospective clients and qualify their interest, urgency, and fit

Book qualified sales calls for closers and help maintain a full calendar

Follow up consistently with leads who have shown interest but have not yet booked

Re-engage old leads and no-shows to generate more booked calls

Build rapport quickly and communicate clearly with prospects

Use scripts, sales processes, and setter frameworks provided by the company

Track outreach, follow-ups, booked calls, and outcomes accurately in the CRM or tracking sheet

Work closely with closers and sales leadership to improve show-up rates and conversion quality

Attend daily training, call reviews, and team meetings

Continuously improve through coaching, feedback, and performance reviews

Support the sales team with other related tasks as assigned



Who Will Do Well in This Role

This role is a strong fit for someone who is:

Hungry to make money and grow fast

Highly coachable and open to feedback

A fast learner who can improve quickly

Resilient and not discouraged by rejection or follow-up

Organized and consistent with lead follow-up

Competitive, proactive, and performance-driven

Comfortable working in a high-accountability environment

Interested in sales, persuasion, and the high-ticket coaching industry



Preferred Background

We strongly prefer candidates who have:

Previous experience as a setter, appointment setter, DM setter, inbound/outbound sales rep, or closer support

Experience in the education, coaching, consulting, or high-ticket offer industry

Experience selling or setting for offers in the $6,000 to $20,000 range, or similar high-ticket offers

Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken

Experience speaking with prospects through chat and phone

Candidates with direct setter or sales experience in the education or high-ticket coaching industry will be given strong preference.



Requirements

Very fluent in English

Excellent written communication and conversational selling skills

Confident speaking with leads on the phone and Zoom calls

Strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail

Able to work independently and hit performance goals remotely

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment

Able to work full-time and fully commit to this role

Able to attend team training, daily call review, and coaching sessions

Willing to learn PMA’s sales process and improve quickly



Work Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

Schedule may vary based on team needs, but candidates must be able to work during U.S. business hours. Minimum hours are 3pm EST - 10pm EST and 5 hours during the weekend.

This role is best suited for someone who can fully focus on PMA.

 If you currently have another full-time job, please do not apply.



Compensation

Base salary: $1,000 USD per month + performance-based commission

A good setter is expected to make more than $2,000-$4000 USD per month

Strong performers can earn significantly more based on results

This is a performance-driven role with real upside. For reference, our top closer/sales rep is earning $20,000 USD per month, and we are building a team of winners who want to grow into high-income sales professionals.



Benefits

Fully remote work

Performance-based compensation with strong upside

Company-provided sales and setter training

Daily call review and coaching

Ongoing mentorship and feedback from leadership

Opportunity to grow into a senior setter, closer, or sales leadership role

Work with a fast-growing education company changing people’s careers

Be part of a mission-driven company with a strong growth culture

Learn high-ticket sales in a real business with proven offers

Access to selected company training resources

Annual company-paid retreat — this year, we are going to South Africa



Company Culture

At PM Accelerator, we value:

Growth mindset

Coachability

Speed and execution

Ownership and accountability

Excellence and service

Making a real impact in people’s lives

We believe in helping our team members grow quickly, master their craft, and become leaders in their field.

PMA also donates a percentage of earnings to educational nonprofits that support entrepreneurship and mentorship for children from underserved communities.

Watch Dr. Nancy Li’s Forbes interview to learn more about the company and culture:

 



Why Join PMA

This is not just another remote job.

 This is an opportunity to learn high-ticket sales, work with a fast-growing brand, and build an income based on performance.

If you are hungry, driven, and serious about becoming excellent in sales, this role can open the door to long-term growth.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume through the job board where this position is posted.

 Do not
 your application directly, as it may get lost.

In your application, please answer:

Why do you want to work for PM Accelerator?

Why are you a strong fit for this setter role?

What experience do you have in setting, sales, or high-ticket coaching / education offers?

All shortlisted applicants may receive a take-home assignment and interview as part of the hiring process.

title: Heir Property Acquisitions Specialist – Tax Delinquent & Multi-Heir Properties
description:
We are a Texas-based real estate investor specializing in tax-delinquent and heir properties. Our goal is to help families resolve back taxes, liens, and messy title issues by securing sign-overs or partial-interest purchases so we can clear the property and either fix-and-flip, wholesale, or hold it.

This is NOT a high-volume cold-calling role. We focus on low-volume, high-depth, consultative conversations. You will build genuine rapport, map full family trees, uncover pain points, and persistently contact every necessary heir/sibling/co-owner — even if the first person says “no” — to gather information for affidavits of heirship and secure sign-overs or majority interest.

Schedule

Full-time – 40 hours per week (8 paid hours per day)

Daily hours, you pick: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM CST

(with one 1-hour unpaid break)

I would love someone who can work both Saturday and Sunday. I'm flexible on the schedule though. So no weekends isn't a deal breaker 

(Perfect schedule: 10am-7pm. Wednesday–Sunday)



Key Responsibilities:

Work provided skip-traced tax-delinquent and heir lists (multiple phone numbers per lead).

Make targeted dials daily— quality over quantity.

Build deep rapport and have longer, consultative conversations.

Ask discovery questions to uncover pain points (tax stress, inheritance burdens, family disputes, maintenance costs, etc.).

Map the full family tree and contact siblings, co-heirs, or anyone else who must sign paperwork.

If the primary contact doesn’t answer or declines, immediately research and reach the other family members to keep the opportunity alive.

Gather detailed heir information needed for affidavits of heirship and partial-interest agreements.

Log accurate notes in our CRM on each family member’s position and motivations.

All calls are recorded for coaching and quality.



Compensation:

Base pay (the wage listed is base pay only and does not include bonuses).

You will also earn performance bonuses for every closed deal.

Solid performers who consistently get deals will receive pay increases — the more money you help me make, the more I’m willing to pay.



Additional compensation is provided for bilingual Spanish speakers.



Job Requirements:

Excellent spoken English with a clear, warm, professional phone presence.

Strong natural rapport-building and listening skills.

Comfortable with persistence and pivoting conversations smoothly (e.g., turning a “no” into contacting other heirs).

Must be comfortable using Screenshot Monitor (we provide the account and training) for time tracking and coaching purposes.

Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and quality headset.

Coachable and excited to learn Texas heirship laws, UPHPA, and our exact process.

Mandatory Application Step: Complete the free DISC behavioral assessment and attach the PDF with your results to your application.


  



-Applications without the DISC PDF will not be considered.-

To Apply

Reply with:

1. Your completed DISC test PDF (required)

2. A voice recording (Read the sample script below naturally)

3. Reply with your preferred schedule CST. I would like your working schedule to be (Wednesday - Sunday) Weekends have the highest pick up rate which means you will close more deals and earn more bonuses. Im open to what schedule works best for you. 





Sample Script:

Hey Hubert, this is [Your First Name]. I do genealogy and title work here in Texas, Do you happen to know [Deceased’s Full Name] by chance?

title: Freight Forwarding Operations & Process Specialist (Remote | Full-time)
description:
Hours: 40 hrs/week | Rate: USD 5–7/hr | Start: ASAP | Location: Remote | Contract: Long-term

Pay: Weekly | Trial: 2-week paid trial (performance-based continuation + possible immediate rate increase)



ABOUT VLYOU

VLYOU builds and runs smooth operations for clients. Our core is process excellence: clear standards, checklists, quality control, and continuous improvement, supported by automation and AI. We are not just executing their processes, we are defining them and improving their service delivery by doing so. We are small (one person in The Netherlands and four in the Philipines), but have great ambitions to grow our business and we need you to do that.



Your primary assignment will be supporting our client CargoCare NL (freight forwarding). Over time you may also support other clients (including our own E-commerce website 
) when priorities shift and it fits your personal interests and skills.



ROLE SUMMARY

We’re hiring a Freight Forwarding Operations & Process Specialist who can execute freight forwarding work with high quality and also think in processes and process improvement.

You will start by executing existing SOPs (so you can contribute fast), and gradually expand into documenting/improving SOPs together with the team and the client.



WHAT YOU’LL DO (EXECUTION FIRST, THEN IMPROVEMENT)

Execution (primary in the beginning)

• Run day-to-day freight forwarding tasks using existing SOPs and checklists - Our standards support you while your skills lead the way.

• Create / maintain shipment files in our freight forwarding software Scope (Riege) and keep data clean and up to date.

• Monitor carrier updates and schedule changes (ETD/ETA changes, amendments) and process them correctly.

• Submit / verify shipping milestones and key portal actions (e.g., VGM / Shipping Instructions in carrier portals when required).

• Coordinate documents and stakeholders: booking confirmations/amendments, pre-alerts, transport documents (HBL/MBL/CMR), handovers, and follow-ups for missing information.

• Provide proactive, consolidated status updates to avoid surprises.



Quality & escalation (always)

• Work with high standards: accuracy, completeness, and clear documentation. Quality first, efficiency second.

• Use checklists, QA steps, and “four-eyes” principles where required.

• Follow exception & escalation standards: escalate early with educated, targeted questions (not vague open questions).



Process building (grows over time)

• Help improve existing SOPs and create new SOPs in Notion (process documentation + continuous improvement).

• Identify recurring issues/root causes and propose fixes (process, checklist, tooling, automation, training).



MUST-HAVES

• At least 3 years of Freight forwarding experience within the last 5 years is required (you understand the logistics world and can get productive and proactive quickly). Note: this is a hard requirement!

• Fluent in English (C2 or higher), both spoken and written - communication is the foundation for quality

• Strong attention to detail and a “quality-first” mindset.

• Proactive communicator: clear updates, ownership, and initiative.

• Process mindset: you can follow SOPs precisely and also improve them.

• Comfortable using AI to work faster and better (drafting, checking, summarizing, creating checklists/SOPs).

• Stable internet + your own computer.



NICE-TO-HAVES

• Experience to work with European companies, or even better, in The Netherlands (Rotterdam Port)

• Experience with Scope (Riege) or similar forwarding systems (pré, not required).

• Customs coordination experience and/or Recruitment or staffing support experience (pré), as we may expand activities in those areas.

• Experience with process optimization / SOP writing / (AI) automation.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH

• Start at $5–7/hr (weekly payments) - we pay in Euro (Euro range: €4 - 6). Starting payment is defined based on relevant experience.

• 2-week paid trial: if performance is above expectations, rate can be increased immediately up to 10% - so show us everything you've got! ;-).

• Twice-per-year salary review (max 20% increase per year).

• Quarterly team bonus up to one week salary per quarter (plus occasional extra bonuses).



WORKING HOURS:

• Flexible, as long as we (as a team) can deliver excellent service to our customers. In practice, we see most activities are expected to take place between 08:00 and 18:00 CET, Monday to Friday.



AVAILABILITY / FOCUS

We need someone dedicated. If you currently have other obligations, that’s okay on the short term — but you must be transparent. We understand you might need some time to free yourself from other obligations. Long-term, we expect full focus on our work (no ongoing side freelance jobs). That is: we accept that you spend some time on other obligations in the first month, but expect full dedication after that. We are flexible and we believe acceptable working hours will help to promote health and stay focused, so we don't expect you to work day and night, but we do have a hard rule of not taking up any other work- or study when working for us to avoid conflicting situations.



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT – REQUIRED)

To be considered, you MUST answer the questions below in numbered format. Applications that skip questions will be rejected without explanation - we want to focus our time on candidates who are considering their application the way we would like you to put attention on your work.

Also: start your application message with the word “VESSEL”.



1) Freight forwarding background: years of experience, import/export, sea/air/road, and your typical responsibilities.

2) Describe 1 real example of an exception you handled (e.g., schedule change, missing docs, portal issue). What did you do and how did you communicate it?

3) Describe a SOP/checklist you followed or created/improved. How did you ensure quality (QA / four-eyes / error prevention)?

4) Confirm: (a) you can work ~40 hrs/week, (b) your expected hourly rate within €4 - 6/hr, (c) when you can start, and (d) any obligations in the next 3 months that could impact availability (job/study/family/holidays). Honesty is valued.



Looking forward to your submission.



Kind regards,



Koen van Dam

Owner VLYOU Value Creation &

title: Cold Caller (Outbound B2B Sales – Amazon Sellers) – Remote, Full-Time EST
description:
APPLY HERE: 



Location: Remote

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (with 1-hour unpaid break daily)

Compensation: $600.00 – $850.00/month

Bonus: +$20.00 for every booked appointment.



About Beyond Seller Growth

Beyond Seller Growth is a fast-growing, startup Amazon agency. Our Core Focus is simple: We give small Amazon businesses a fighting chance.



About the Role

The Cold Caller is the top of BSG's sales engine. You spend your day on the phone with Amazon sellers we've never spoken to before, opening conversations, qualifying the ones who fit, and booking them onto the calendar for our closers. The volume and quality of the meetings you set directly determine how many small Amazon businesses we get to help — your dials drive the entire pipeline.



Key Responsibilities

1. Cold Outreach — Execute a disciplined daily workflow designed to consistently fill the top of the sales funnel. Aggressively dial new leads from prioritized lists and execute systematic follow-up campaigns for unresponsive contacts. Personalize scripts to increase engagement while strictly adhering to calling policies and logging every touchpoint in real-time.

2. Book Appointments — Convert initial conversations into confirmed meetings for the sales team. Using provided talk tracks, identify and qualify prospects against our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Once a lead is validated, secure the calendar appointment and manage the confirmation process for a seamless handoff to the closer.

3. Hit Activity Goals — Meet or exceed specific daily and weekly KPIs. Hit volume targets for dials and talk time, as well as quota goals for booked appointments and attendance rates. Actively track your own performance data to improve conversion rates.

4. Sales Collaboration — Act as a key partner to the broader sales organization, working closely with closers to ensure they have the context needed to win business. Report to the Sales Manager for regular coaching and provide feedback on lead quality or script effectiveness.

5. Use CRM — Maintain impeccable data hygiene. Accurately log every call outcome, detailed lead note, and follow-up task directly into BeyondCTO’s CRM without delay. Strictly follow defined pipeline stages and workflows.

6. Brand Reputation Outreach (Amazon Reviews) — Protect and improve the brand’s reputation by proactively contacting customers who have left negative Amazon reviews. Use our compliant process to resolve grievances and, where appropriate, encourage updated feedback.



Requirements

- C1 (or above) CEFR level English.

- 1+ year of cold calling or outbound sales experience, ideally B2B, with documented dial and meeting-set numbers.

- Strong spoken English — clear, confident, neutral-to-American accent that builds trust with US-based business owners.

- Thick skin and the ability to keep call energy high through rejection, gatekeepers, and bad days.

- Disciplined work ethic — you don't need a manager standing over you to hit your dial count.

- Comfortable with high-volume dialing tools, power dialers, or auto-dialers, and CRM logging (HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive, or similar).

- Coachable — you take feedback on your calls and adjust the next dial, not next week.

- Excellent CRM and pipeline hygiene; you treat documentation as part of the job, not a chore.

- Quiet, professional home-office environment with zero background noise on calls.



Technical Requirements

- Display setup (required): dual monitors, each 24" or larger, OR a single 42" or larger display. Working from a laptop is acceptable as long as the external monitor(s) meet this specification.

- Minimum 8GB RAM

- Minimum 25 Mbps internet speed



Core Values

1. Get The Thing Done (Execution > Activity)

2. Check Your Ego (Humility > Pride)

3. Speed Sparks Learning (Iteration > Perfection)

4. Deliver Value, Minimize Noise (Pragmatism > Drama)

The Sales Closer is the final mile between an interested Amazon seller and a signed BSG client. title: Full-Time Video Editor Nicky Gordo Show
description:
We're hiring a full-time video editor for the Nicky Gordo Show, a fast-growing podcast hosted by Fat Nick (400% QoQ growth, sponsors include BoomBoom, Rotten Candy, Triumph Arcade).



This is not a freelance gig. This is a full-time seat on a real team that's building something. If you're good and you stay sharp, there's room to grow with us.



READ THIS FIRST — NO AI SLOP



We don't want AI-generated edits. No Opus Clip, no Submagic auto-captions, no AI auto-zoom, no AI scene detection doing the work for you. We can spot it instantly and we'll cut the trial on day one if we see it.

Every edit needs to be done by a human who watched the clip, picked the 
nt, timed the cut, and made real decisions. If your workflow is "dump the episode into an AI tool and ship what it spits out," do not apply. We're paying for taste and judgment, not for someone to babysit a tool we could run ourselves for free.

You can use AI to assist (transcription, rough cuts, captions as a starting point) but the final edit has to be yours. We'll know.



What you'll deliver every week:

20 short-form clips from Nicky Gordo Show episodes (vertical, captioned, optimized for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts). Clean cuts, punchy hooks in the first 2 seconds, on-brand pacing.

YouTube long-form audio censoring. We hand you the edited episode, you go through it and bleep/mute specific curse words so it's YouTube-monetization safe. Clean, consistent censor sound, no missed words, no awkward gaps.

10 additional short edits for Reels (TikTok + YouTube) from AB6 artist content, music videos, behind the scenes, etc.

Non-negotiables:

Available Mondays and Thursdays for weekly check-ins (we'll align on a time zone that works).

Fast turnaround. We post on a schedule and we don't miss.

You actually watch and understand the content. The Nicky Gordo Show has a specific tone — unhinged, comedic, internet-native. If you don't get it, this isn't the job for you.

Sharp ear for the audio censor pass. You need to catch every flagged word. One miss and the video gets demonetized.

You take direction but also bring ideas. If you see a 
nt in an episode that we missed, flag it.

What you need:

Strong portfolio of short-form content edited by hand (send links, not screenshots).

Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve proficiency. After Effects is a plus.

Reliable internet, reliable computer, reliable communication.

English good enough to follow nuanced creative direction and recognize curse words by ear.

How to apply:

Send a short message telling me why this job. Attach 3-5 examples of short-form edits you've done — ideally for podcasts, comedy, or music content. No generic reels. No AI-tool outputs.

If you've watched the Nicky Gordo Show before applying, mention something specific you'd cut differently or better. That moves you to the top of the pile.

title: Book Warm Leads, Earn $210-$255/wk | US Outbound Appointment Setter | Tue-Sat PT
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

Book warm, exclusive leads for a US licensed sales team. No cold calling. Real bonuses you control. Established operation, working systems, full support from day one.



Every lead you call already raised their hand. They filled out a benefits card, requested information, or are existing clients due for a review. They expect a call from us. Your job is simple: reach them, qualify their interest, and book the Zoom appointment with the right agent.



If you can book appointments, this role pays you for every part of the result. The call. The show. The sale.



EARNINGS BREAKDOWN:

This role pays three ways. Every dollar above base is tied to a specific outcome you control.



1. Base Pay. $3.00/hr × 40 hours = $120/week, paid every Friday via Remitly.

2. Show Bonus. $5.00 for every Qualifying Show (lead joins Zoom for 10+ minutes). Unlocks at a 35% weekly show rate. Average week: 10 shows = $50.

3. Sale Bonus. $10.00 for every Surviving Sale (policy issues and stays in force 30 days). Unlocks at 9 shows per week. Average week: 4 sales = $40.



REALISTIC WEEKLY EARNINGS:

TARGET WEEK — $120 base + $50 show bonus + $40 sale bonus = $210

STRONG WEEK — $120 base + $75 show bonus + $60 sale bonus = $255

TOP PERFORMER — $120 base + $100 show bonus + $80 sale bonus = $300



No hidden caps. No "up to" language. The math is the math. The harder you book, the more you earn.



YOUR WORKDAY:

Tuesday through Saturday, Pacific Time.



Morning block: 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM PT

Break: 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM PT (unpaid, two hours)

Afternoon block: 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM PT



40 hours, every week.



You will call warm leads, send the texts we give you, qualify interest, and book Zoom appointments on our agents' calendars. We provide the phone numbers, the scripts, the leads, the calendar access, and a custom AI assistant built in-house to coach you through objections in real time.



You bring the energy and the dial discipline. We bring everything else.



WHO WE WANT:

You speak clean, confident, US-neutral English.

You have outbound calling experience and you are not afraid of the phone.

You have booked appointments before. Insurance, solar, home services, telecom, real estate, financial services, or B2B all transfer well.

You log your activity without being chased.

You can work Tuesday to Saturday on Pacific Time. Be honest with yourself about this one.

You take direct feedback and apply it immediately.

You do not need to be licensed. You do not sell. You book. Our agents close.

You will need a VPN; however, we will provide the Calling System.



AN ESTABLISHED OPERATION:

We run a focused team. Our agents are licensed, our leads are warm, our systems are built, and our infrastructure is in place. The person who joins us steps into a working operation, not a startup experiment. You get the tools, the training, and the team support to hit your numbers from week one.



HOW TO APPLY:

In your application message, answer these three questions in writing. Short, direct answers are best.



1. What is the highest sustained call volume you have ever hit in a single day? Give the number, the role, and the type of leads.



2. Will you commit to Tuesday through Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM Pacific Time, for at least the next 6 months? Yes or no.



3. A lead picks up and says "I don't remember filling anything out. Take me off your list." You have 15 seconds before they hang up. Write the exact words you would say to keep them on the line.



Applications that skip these questions, give vague answers, or rewrite the questions will not be reviewed.



We are reviewing applications as they arrive and hiring the first qualified setter we connect with. Apply now.

title: Accountant
description:
US Accountant

Aoede LLC | 100% Remote | Full-Time



About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized US Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations, financial recordkeeping, reconciliations, payroll support, compliance filings, and reporting activities. The ideal candidate has experience with US accounting processes, property-related accounting, and accounting software such as QuickBooks and AppFolio.





What You'll Do



Accounts Receivable (AR)

• Monitor incoming payments related to rent payments

• Verify outstanding rent balances from Assistant Property Manager

• Verify payment postings and resolve discrepancies



Accounts Payable (AP)

• Verify vendor invoices, bills, and supporting documentation 

• Organize and maintain AP invoices and receipts

• Record bills and expenses accurately in the accounting system

• Prepare and process vendor payments



Payroll Administration

• Maintain employee timesheets with accuracy and completeness

• Process payroll through Gusto

• Record payroll journal entries and payroll-related liabilities

• Maintain payroll records

• Assist with payroll tax compliance and reporting

 

Bank & Credit Card Management

• Record bank statement transactions accurately

• Record and categorize credit card transactions and expenses

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations

• Perform monthly credit card reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies



Accounting & Financial Reporting

• Prepare necessary adjusting journal entries

• Maintain accurate general ledger records

• Ensure all accounts are reconciled



Tax & Compliance Support

• Prepare and maintain 1099 forms for vendors

• Assist with W-2 preparation and payroll documentation

• Monitor and maintain records for property tax and MUD tax balances and due dates

• Track annual filing deadlines and compliance requirements

• Assist with state and local filings as needed



Audit & Documentation

• Prepare audit support documents and schedules

• Organize financial records for audits and compliance reviews

• Maintain accurate and accessible digital filing systems



Task & Team Coordination

• Manage accounting-related tasks

• Provide weekly presentations to the team

• Coordinate with property managers, vendors, and internal staff regarding accounting matters

• Assist management with special projects and financial analysis



Additional Responsibilities

• Maintain organized accounting files and documentation

• Monitor recurring expenses and subscriptions

• Ensure compliance with company accounting policies and procedures

• Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned





What We're Looking For



• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred

• Experience with US accounting and bookkeeping practices

• Familiarity with property management accounting is a plus

• Experience using accounting and payroll software

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

• Strong organizational and analytical skills

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities

• Strong communication and reporting skills





What We Offer



• 100% remote position — work from home

• Long-term role with real growth potential

• Raises considered at performance evaluations for those who master the training material and execute at a high level

• Extensive runbooks and tutorials to support your development

• Annual team bonding trips in the Philippines

• A team culture that values hard work, initiative, and continuous learning





Our Hiring Process



1. Apply — Submit your application with the details listed below

2. Initial Review — We review your experience and qualifications

3. Assessment — Qualified candidates receive a TestGorilla skills assessment (~1 hour, webcam required)

4. Interview — Candidates who score at or above the 50th percentile are invited to a Zoom interview

5. Offer & Onboarding — Successful candidates begin with a 3-month probation period with full training and support





Frequently Asked Questions



What types of properties will I manage?

You'll support a diversified portfolio that includes a 70-unit commercial building in Houston, single-family rental homes in California, and short-term rental (Airbnb) properties in Austin. This role gives you broad exposure across multiple property types.



What are the working hours?

You will be expected to work US Central Time business hours. This is a full-time position (40 hours/week).



How and when do I get paid?

Pay is on the 1st and 15th of each month via Wise (
).



Is this freelance or full-time?

This is a full-time, dedicated position. Freelancing or side work is not allowed. We need your full commitment.



Do you provide equipment?

You must have your own laptop, headset, and reliable high-speed internet connection.



Is there a probation period?

Yes, there is a 3-month probation period. After that, performance evaluations are conducted every 6 months.



How do raises and bonuses work?

We offer on-the-spot bonuses for exceptional work. Raises are considered at your 6-month performance evaluations based on how well you learn the training material and execute your responsibilities.



What training and support do you provide?

We have extensive runbooks, tutorials, and experienced tea
mbers to help you get up to speed. We invest in people who are willing to learn.



What software will I need to learn?

AppFolio (property management), QuickBooks (accounting), Asana (task management), Slack (communication), and Zoom (meetings). If you don't know all of these yet, that's okay — what matters is your willingness to learn quickly.



---



To Apply



Please include:

1. A brief summary of your accounting experience

2. Which Western countries you've supported (if any)

3. What types of properties you've managed (commercial, residential, short-term rental)

4. What  accounting software you've used

5. Your availability to start





About Aoede LLC



Aoede LLC is a Texas-based property management company overseeing a growing, diversified portfolio of commercial, single-family, and short-term rental properties across Texas and California. Founded with the mindset of a startup but built on enterprise-level professional experience, we move fast, build smart, and hold ourselves to a high standard.



Our team of 10+ professionals spans multiple countries and operates fully remote, managing everything from a 70-unit commercial building in Houston to Airbnb properties in Austin and single-family rentals in California. We hire talent from around the world — including the Philippines, Vietnam, India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Venezuela, and beyond. We don't care where you sit. We care how you perform.



What makes us different: we combine the speed and scrappiness of a startup with the processes, structure, and professionalism you'd expect from a much larger organization. We invest heavily in documentation — our runbooks and tutorials are built so that the right person can get up to speed quickly and operate independently. We reward performance, not tenure. If you learn the material, execute at a high level, and take ownership of your work, you'll grow here.



Our culture is built on communication, collaboration, and humility. We operate as a team — not in silos. Everyone, from leadership down, is open to feedback and willing to hear what they need to do to improve. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. What we do is strive for continuous improvement and learning every single day. Leadership is genuinely invested in finding better ways to do things, and we expect the same mindset from everyone on the team.





A Note on Honesty



We value honesty over impressive claims. Please don't tell us you're an expert in something you've only read about or briefly touched. It's okay to say "I've used AppFolio a few times but I'm not an expert" or "I haven't handled evictions before but I'm willing to learn." We will find out the truth — whether it's during the assessment, the interview, or the first week on the job. And when we do, it damages trust that's very hard to rebuild.



We would much rather hire someone who says "I don't know that yet, but I'll learn it" than someone who claims to know everything and can't deliver. Being humble, honest about where you are, and willing to put in the work to grow — that's what gets you far here. We have the training, the runbooks, and the team support to get the right person up to speed. What we can't teach is integrity.



We're actively expanding our portfolio and our team. We do annual team bonding trips because we believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself.



This is a company where your work matters, your voice is heard, and your growth is directly tied to what you put in.

title: Senior Operations Support Coordinator — High-Ownership Role (Remote, PST Hours, Long-Term)
description:
Senior Operations Support Coordinator - High-Ownership Role (Remote, PST Hours, Long-Term)



American Standard Adhesives, Inc. 



Remote  |  Full-Time  |  Fixed PST Hours 



Reports To: Owner 



Works Closely With: Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist 



Department: Operations 



Status: Full-Time 



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST 



Location: Remote (PST hours required) 



 



About the Company 



American Standard Adhesives, Inc. (ASA) is a U.S.-based manufacturer and distributor of industrial adhesive products, serving a diverse base of customers across multiple industries. Our lean team plays a critical role in keeping our day-to-day operations running smoothly and our customers well-served. 



1. Position Summary 



This is not an entry-level VA role. We are hiring a senior operator who can own recurring workflow, coordinate across teams, and escalate well. If you are looking for light remote work or a side gig, please do not apply.



The Operations Support Coordinator is a senior supportive role that helps the Owner run the day-to-day operational workflow of American Standard Adhesives. This person owns the repetitive, structured, and recurring tasks across the operation, and serves as a coordination point between back office, warehouse, accounting, and sales support functions. 



This is a support role, not a decision-making role. The Owner retains all final decision-making authority over pricing, commitments, disputes, personnel, and policy. The Operations Support Coordinator is empowered to execute within established SOPs and Work Instructions, to coordinate across teams, and to escalate exceptions promptly. 



The Operations Support Coordinator works side-by-side with the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist, who manages the day-to-day order workflow. This role requires a working understanding of the order processing function so that coverage, overflow, and escalation handling are seamless. 



2. Key Responsibilities 



A. Order & Back Office Coordination — ~30% 



Support the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist with order flow, including purchase order handling, invoicing, and customer acknowledgments. 



Monitor the open order queue daily; flag bottlenecks and aging orders to the Owner. 



Coordinate between back office and warehouse on daily outbound orders. 



Maintain visibility across online and third-party platforms, as well as direct customer order channels. 



Provide coverage for the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist during absences or peak volume. 



B. Shipping & Warehouse Coordination — ~20% 



Coordinate shipping label creation and communicate with the warehouse on daily picking and shipping. 



Coordinate parcel and pallet shipments across all channels. 



Liaise with the warehouse team on picking and shipping. 



Ensure shipping documentation is accurate and filed. 



Confirm end-of-day shipment closure with the warehouse through direct communication. 



C. Import & Vendor Coordination — ~15% 



Support recurring import workflows, including container tracking and customs follow-up. 



Manage the vendor
 channel: monitoring, routing, and filing per company work instructions. 



Maintain vendor files and supporting documentation. 



Draft vendor communications for Owner review when commitments are involved. 



D. Compliance, Insurance & Risk — ~10% 



Coordinate contractor file tracking, insurance certificate collection, and renewal calendars. 



Support tenant verification and related compliance workflows where applicable. 



Keep compliance records organized per company file-naming guidelines. 



E. Recurring Administrative & Systems Tasks — ~15% 



File and folder organization across company systems, per internal guidelines. 



Accounting system data entry support (bookkeeping execution only — not financial decisions). 



Pull and format operational and margin reports for Owner review. 



Maintain quality assurance and product documentation. 



Support system administration tasks under Owner direction. 



F. Project-Based & Ad Hoc Support — ~10% 



Support insurance renewals, hiring and recruitment coordination, and SOP documentation. 



Prepare case or claim files for Owner review. 



Handle time-sensitive special tasks requiring independent follow-up within pre-approved scope. 



3. Authority & Decision Boundaries 



This is an execution and coordination role, not a decision-making role. Clarity here protects the business and the person in the role. 



The Operations Support Coordinator MAY: 



Execute any task covered by an existing Work Instruction or SOP. 



Coordinate teammates, vendors, and carriers within pre-approved scope. 



Draft communications, quotations, and documents for Owner review. 



Flag exceptions, risks, and decision points upward promptly and in writing. 



Provide data, summaries, and recommendations to help the Owner d
 faster. 



The Operations Support Coordinator MAY NOT (without Owner approval): 



Approve pricing, discounts, credit terms, or payment terms. 



Commit the company to vendor contracts, service agreements, or long-term arrangements. 



Approve refunds, returns outside written policy, or customer concessions. 



Approve hiring, terminations, promotions, or compensation changes. 



Change SOPs, policies, or approve new processes without written Owner sign-off. 



Resolve disputes involving material money, legal exposure, or customer retention. 



When in doubt, escalate. Speed and clarity of escalation is valued over independent judgment on gray-area items. 



4. Qualifications 



Required 



Minimum 3 years of full-time professional experience in a corporate or BPO environment (operations, logistics, customer service, or back office support). 5+ years strongly preferred. Freelance, VA marketplace, or solo remote work alone does not qualify. 



Working knowledge of general accounting software, shipping software, Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Excel), and business phone systems. 



Strong English communication — written and spoken — with a clear, concise, professional tone. 



Proven ability to follow SOPs and Work Instructions precisely. 



Excellent organization; able to work within existing file naming and folder structures without disturbing them. 



Disciplined on escalation: knows what to d
, what to ask, and what to document. 



Ability to handle a mix of repetitive and non-repetitive tasks with minimal supervision. 



Preferred 



Import/export or logistics coordination exposure. 



Industrial supply, distribution, or manufacturing background. 



Experience supporting an owner-operated small or mid-size business. 



Analytical or accounting background. 



5. What We’re Looking For 



Highly organized with strong attention to detail. 



Proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than letting them escalate. 



Reliable, self-managed, and comfortable in a fast-paced, lean team environment. 



Comfortable managing multiple priorities and shifting tasks throughout the day. 



Mature judgment — knows when to act, when to ask, and when to escalate. 



Operates well under clear boundaries and is comfortable supporting, not leading. 



6. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 



Zero preventable shipping errors. 



Vendor
 inbox processed daily with no unrouted items older than 24 hours. 



Daily visibility of order queue status reported to the Owner. 



Backup coverage established for the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist on core order workflow tasks. 



All escalations documented with context and a recommended next step. 



7. Reporting & Working Relationships 



Reports directly to the Owner. 



Works daily alongside the Customer Service & Order Processing Specialist. 



Coordinates with the warehouse team, accounting, and service / vendor contacts. 



Escalates customer or partner-facing decisions to the Owner. 



8. Schedule Requirements 



Full-time, Monday–Friday. 



Fixed PST schedule: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PST or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM PST. 



No flexi-time or alternative schedules. 



Must be fully available during PST business hours. 



9. Compensation 



Competitive rate based on experience. 

Minimum Hourly Rate: $7 USD/hour (starting rate)

Long-term, stable engagement with room to grow.



10. Required from applicants:



Resume

ID Proof verified

Video intro (required, not optional)

Full-time availability confirmed

PST schedule confirmed (8–4 PST or 9–5 PST)

title: Coo Ecommerce Brand Direct Response
description:
BRAND GENERAL MANAGER

Direct Response Ecommerce | Eight Figures | Scaling



---



THE BUSINESS



We are an eight-figure direct response ecommerce brand operating in 

the United States market. Cold traffic acquisition across Meta and 

emerging channels, advertorial and VSL funnel architecture, full OTO 

stack, Shopify and Amazon distribution, subscription and replenishment 

economics. Founder-operated, profitable, no outside capital. We are 

expanding into a multi-brand portfolio over the next four to eight 

quarters.



---



THE SEAT



This is the second seat in the company.



The founder owns creative direction, media buying strategy, and brand 

vision. You own everything else operationally. The mandate is simple 

to state and demanding to execute: build the operational layer that 

allows the brand to run without the founder's daily involvement.



This is not a strategy-only role. This is not a corporate position. 

This is the seat for an operator who has carried operational weight 

inside a real ecommerce business and now wants to apply that experience 

inside a brand that has already found the signal and is scaling.



---



WHO YOU ARE



You have operated inside direct response ecommerce. You have lived 

through the operational reality of running a real business: ad accounts 

that die before launch, suppliers that slip during peak season, funnels 

that worked last quarter and stop working the next.



You speak the language fluently. Advertorial, VSL, OTO architecture, 

AOV, CAC, payback window, LTV, contribution margin, payment processors, 

funnel conversion mechanics, Klaviyo flow design, subscription churn 

dynamics. None of this requires explanation.



You are exceptionally organized. You document. You systematize. You 

build checklists by default. You see disorder as a problem to solve, 

not a condition to accept.



You are flexible. You are not protective of your job description. When 

something new comes up, your first instinct is to figure out how to 

own it, not to ask whether it falls under your role.



You have a strong appetite to learn. You are comfortable being handed 

a problem you have not solved before and you treat it as an opportunity, 

not a threat. You use AI fluently as part of your daily workflow to 

compress weeks of work into days.



---



WHAT YOU OWN



Operations across Shopify, Funnelish, Klaviyo, Amazon Seller Central, 

payment processors, 3PL coordination, and overseas manufacturing.



Customer service function: SOP design, VA hiring and management, 

escalation handling, pattern analysis across channels.



Supply chain end to end: manufacturer coordination, lead time 

management, quality control on incoming stock, backup supplier sourcing, 

trademark and legal resolution.



Sale calendar and asset planning: annual promotional calendar, backward 

planning for every launch, briefing asset owners, deadline ownership, 

post-sale recap.



Quality assurance: final checkpoint on every asset before it ships. 

Advertorials, OTOs, product pages, lifecycle
s, Amazon listings. 

Rejection back to owner with specific fixes. Never the rework department.



Vendor and tool management: subscriptions, renewals, audits, backup 

infrastructure.



Compliance and ad account risk: appeals, documentation, legal counsel 

coordination, account diversification strategy.



Hiring under operations: customer service VA, bookkeeper, technical 

builder, Amazon specialist, additional video editors as the team scales.



Reporting: weekly written summary to the founder, monthly business 

review with KPIs across the portfolio, quarterly planning.



Portfolio expansion: as additional brands launch over the next four 

to eight quarters, you own the operational build-out of each one. You 

are the operator who makes new brand launches repeatable.



---



WHAT YOU DO NOT OWN



Creative strategy. Media buying execution. Brand vision. The founder 

keeps these and works with you as your closest strategic partner.



---



THE FOUNDER TRANSITION



The defining context of this role is the transition from a founder-led 

operation to one that runs without the founder's daily input. This is 

not a clean handover into a vacuum. You are stepping into a seat 

previously held by the founder, who remains deeply invested in the 

business and becomes your closest collaborator.



The first three to six months are a trust-building phase. You will 

work closely together, demonstrate judgment, and earn the decision 

rights of the seat before operating fully independently. Comfort with 

that dynamic, patience to navigate it, and the maturity not to mistake 

collaboration for interference are non-negotiable.



---



REQUIREMENTS



Four or more years of operational experience inside direct response 

ecommerce.



Demonstrated fluency in funnel mechanics: advertorial, VSL, OTO 

architecture, post-purchase upsell stacks.



Hands-on experience with Meta and Google compliance for direct response 

products.



Operational fluency in Shopify, Klaviyo, Funnelish or equivalent funnel 

platforms, payment processors, and Amazon Seller Central.



Direct experience coordinating with overseas contract manufacturers, 

or a credible willingness to step into an existing relationship and 

own it within the first quarter.



Native or near-native written and spoken English.



Working hours with at least four hours of daily overlap with GMT+4.



AI-fluent in daily practice. You operate with Claude, ChatGPT, or 

equivalent as part of your standard workflow.



---



HOW TO APPLY





1. A four-minute Loom answering one question: walk us through the most 

   complex operational challenge you have owned inside a direct response 

   ecommerce business. The context, the stakes, what you did, what you 

   would do differently. Specific numbers, not adjectives.



2. Resume or LinkedIn profile.



3. Two references from your operating history, contactable.



No cover letters. No AI-generated introductions. We watch every Loom 

personally. If the first thirty seconds feel templated, we move on.

title: Sales Assistant for U.S.-Based B2B Sales Team — Excellent English Required (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About Us

We're a U.S.-based B2B appointment-setting company. We help businesses fill their calendars with qualified sales meetings — and we've been doing it for years. We're growing, and we need a sharp, detail-obsessed sales assistant to support one of our senior sales leaders directly.

This isn't a call center role. This isn't data entry. This is a real seat on a real sales team — and the right person is going to learn a TON about how B2B sales actually works in the U.S. market.



What You'll Actually Do

1. Lead Sourcing (the core of the role)



Source qualified leads using LinkedIn Sales Navigator (we'll provide access)

Hunt for leads through organic search across a variety of websites

Vet the quality of every lead by checking their website AND their social media pages — we don't want junk leads, we want REAL prospects

Build clean, organized lead lists ready for our sales team to act on



2. Follow-Up Support



Assist our sales team with follow-up strategy on every recent prospect meeting

Make sure NO lead falls through the cracks — ever

Help draft and track follow-up communications



3. Sales Calendar & Pipeline Organization



Organize and maintain our sales team's calendar

Track every deal: closed sales, likely sales needing proposals, leads that need follow-up now, leads to nurture for later, and leads that didn't convert

Keep our pipeline clean, current, and actionable



4. Other things as needed — this role will likely grow into more responsibilities over time. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



The Real Goal of This Role

Simple: Everyone who intends to buy actually DOES buy. And everyone who needs follow-up actually GETS IT.

If you can own that outcome, you'll do well here.



What We Need From You



EXCELLENT spoken English — clear, professional, easy to understand

EXCELLENT written English — proper grammar, professional tone, no awkward phrasing

Strong attention to detail (we'll test this)

Comfort with LinkedIn Sales Navigator (or willingness to learn fast)

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, working headset/mic

Organized, self-directed, and proactive — we don't want to chase you

Available 40 hours/week aligned with U.S. business hours



Compensation & Growth



a. $200 USD/week to start (40 hrs/week, paid as an independent contractor)

b. This will average $866 USD / MO, though months with 4 pay periods will equal $800 USD and months with 5 pay periods will equal $1000 USD

c. Room to grow. As you prove yourself and take on more, your pay grows with you. We're not interested in keeping good people underpaid — we're interested in building a long-term team.

d. 13th Month paid as long as you're a contractor in good standing with us as of Jan 1 of each year.



How to Apply — READ THIS CAREFULLY

We get a lot of applications. To make sure we only talk to serious, sharp candidates, please complete the following homework and include it in your application. Applications without the homework will not be reviewed.

Homework (please answer all four):

1. Record a 60-90 second audio or video introduction. Tell us: who you are, your relevant experience, and why you'd be great in this role. (Upload to Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube unlisted and share the link.)

2. Go to LinkedIn and find 3 U.S.-based companies that match this profile: B2B service businesses with 10-50 employees, headquartered in the Midwest United States. For each company, give us:



Company name and website

The name and title of the most likely decision-maker for hiring an outsourced sales/appointment-setting service

One specific reason (based on their website or social media) why they might be a good fit for our service



3. Write a short follow-up
 (under 150 words) to a hypothetical prospect named "Mark" who took a sales meeting with us last Tuesday, said he was "very interested," but hasn't responded to two
s since. The tone should be professional, warm, and create urgency without being pushy.

4. Answer this question in 3-5 sentences: "A lead tells you they're 'definitely interested' but keeps rescheduling the proposal call. What do you do?"



Subject line for your application:

Please use this exact subject line so we know you read the whole post: "Sales Assistant Application — [Your First Name] — I Read the Whole Post"



We'll review every application that includes the complete homework. If we like what we see, we'll invite you to a short interview over Zoom.

Looking forward to meeting you.
