title: Ecommerce customer service/sales rep
description:
Hiring: Customer Support + Sales Assistant (Remote, Full-Time, Light Workload)



Hi everyone, Facundo here.



I run two small US e-commerce stores: one in commercial water and hydration

systems (drinking fountains and bottle refill stations), and one in outdoor

power and forestry equipment (log splitters, wood chippers, attachments). I'm

looking for one friendly, English-fluent person to handle customer support and

sales: live chat,
, and phone, plus simple follow-up with people who

didn't finish their order.



One store is established with a light, steady flow of inquiries. The other is

new and growing fast, with strong projections for this year and next. You'd

start by covering both stores because volume is low. As we grow, you'll focus

on just one.



A few honest things up front:

- The workload is light right now. Think around two live chats and a couple of

  calls per store per day, plus preparing quotes when they come in (quotes

  are the part that takes more time). Most of your day is being available and

  ready, with bursts of activity when chats and calls hit. You'll have plenty

  of downtime, especially the first month while you learn.

- The questions are mostly simple: order status, shipping, "which model fits

  my needs," basic product questions. Some technical questions do come in. At

  first you'll pass those to me; over time you'll learn enough to handle most

  of them yourself.



Because the products are high-ticket (orders from hundreds to several thousand

dollars), the one thing that really matters is clear, confident, natural

English on the phone. You're helping people feel comfortable making a real

purchase and following up so we don't lose them. That's the heart of the job.



What you'll do:

- Answer inbound live chats,
s, and phone calls for both stores

- Follow up by call or
 with leads, quote requests, and abandoned

  checkouts

- Prepare and send quotes

- Help customers pick the right product and answer simple order/product

  questions

- Call customers after delivery to check in and ask for a Trustpilot review

- Keep simple notes updated and pass anything technical to me (at first)

- Light Shopify tasks as you settle in (optional)



Required experience:

- Customer service experience

- Sales rep experience (or sales-related role)

- Strong English and a great attitude (just as important as the experience)



Strongly preferred:

- Shopify experience (admin, orders, fulfillment)



Compensation: $600 to $800/month total (base + performance)

- Base: $600/month at 40 hrs/week

- Commission: 0.4% of every sale you help close, through pre-purchase chat,

  phone call, follow-up
, or abandoned-cart recovery. Organic website

  checkouts where you didn't interact with the customer don't count.

- Review bonus: $10 per published Trustpilot review you bring in from

  post-purchase follow-up calls

- Strong performers clear $800/month or more once they're closing deals



Hours: 9 AM - 5 PM EST, Mon to Fri (US business hours)



Tools we use: Chatra (live chat and
s), Dialpad (phone and text

messages), Shopify, Trello



How you'll learn the role: written SOPs and short video walkthroughs for both

stores, plus a few live training calls with me in your first week or two to

get you up to speed. The first month is paid learning time, so curiosity and

willingness to learn count.



To apply, please submit:

1. Internet speed test result (50 Mbps+ preferred)

2. Typing speed test result (40+ WPM preferred)

3. One paragraph of your written English

4. A 45-second audio sample of your spoken English

5. Your IQ score from your profile (required)

6. Your contact info



Put your favorite dessert in the subject line so I know you actually read

this. (This is just to filter out people who didn't read the post.)



If your English is excellent, say so. I bump base pay for standout candidates.



Looking forward to it.

Facundo

title: Essay Editor/Academic Writer
description:
We’re an academic consulting firm that helps high school students gain admission to top-tier universities in the U.S., and we’re currently seeking a part-time Essay Editor/Academic Writer with strong writing, editing, and critical thinking skills to join our team.



This role is ideal for someone who can take rough or underdeveloped student essays and turn them into polished, well-structured pieces that read naturally and professionally. The position is part-time and flexible, but it’s also deadline-driven and requires strong reliability, responsiveness, and attention to detail.



This is not a general content writing role. We’re specifically looking for someone who can revise and rewrite essays so they are clearer, stronger, and more compelling while still aligning with the original prompt, intended message, and required word count.



Key Responsibilities:

• Edit and rewrite high school-level essays based on specific prompts and word count requirements, improving structure, clarity, grammar, tone, and overall impact.

• Manage multiple essay assignments at once while meeting tight turnaround times, typically within 24-48 hours, and communicate proactively regarding deadlines or issues that may affect delivery.



Applicants should be able to:

• Rewrite and strengthen weak or underdeveloped drafts without losing the original intent, while elevating flow, structure, readability, and overall quality.

• Demonstrate excellent grammar, sentence control, and word choice, and write with a level of polish that reads as fluent and natural in English.



To proceed with your application, please send a message with your resume, 2-3 writing samples for review, and an estimate of how many hours you can commit each week. Candidates who don’t follow these instructions will not be considered for this role or next steps.

title: Tax Administration Coordinator (CPA Liaison)
description:
Aligned Advisors | Oceanside, CA (Remote – PST Hours Required)





About Aligned Advisors



Aligned Advisors (
) is a specialized advisory firm serving dental professionals nationwide. We provide integrated services across accounting, fractional CFO support, tax strategy and compliance, and wealth advisory. Our model is built around precision, proactive planning, and delivering a high-touch client experience to growth-oriented dental practices.



Position Overview



We are seeking a Tax Administration Coordinator (CPA Liaison) to join our team full-time. This role is critical to the success of our tax function, acting as the central point of coordination between Aligned Advisors, our clients, and external CPA firms.



This individual will own the tax workflow process end-to-end, ensuring all required documentation is collected, organized, and delivered accurately and on time. You will play a key operational role in driving efficiency, accountability, and communication across all parties involved in tax preparation.



This is a remote role, but candidates must be available during Pacific Time US (PST) business hours.





Key Responsibilities



- Tax Workflow Management



- Own and manage the full lifecycle of tax return coordination



- Track deadlines and ensure timely delivery of all required documents to CPA partners



- Monitor return progress and proactively follow up to avoid delays



- CPA & Internal Liaison



- Serve as the primary point of contact between Aligned Advisors and external CPA firms



- Translate requests between CPAs, internal tea
mbers, and clients



- Ensure CPAs receive complete, accurate, and organized information



- Client Coordination



- Communicate with clients to request, clarify, and follow up on tax documentation



- Ensure a smooth, professional, and timely client experience throughout tax season



- Document Management



- Upload, organize, and maintain files within ShareFile (or similar systems)



- Ensure all documentation is properly labeled, complete, and accessible



- Maintain clean, audit-ready digital records



- Process Optimization



- Identify inefficiencies and help improve tax workflow systems



- Assist in building standardized processes and checklists





Qualifications



Required:



- 2+ years of experience in a tax, accounting, or administrative support role



- Strong understanding of tax preparation workflows and documentation requirements



- Exceptional organizational and project management skills



- High attention to detail and follow-through



- Strong written and verbal communication skills



- Experience working with document management systems (e.g., ShareFile, Google Drive, etc.)



- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously



Preferred:



- Experience working with CPA firms or tax preparation teams



- Familiarity with dental or healthcare clients (not required but a plus)



- Experience in a remote, fast-paced professional services environment





What Success Looks Like



- Tax returns are consistently delivered on time with minimal CPA back-and-forth



- Documentation is complete, clean, and easy for CPAs to process



- Clients experience proactive, clear communication



- Internal team spends less time chasing information and resolving bottlenecks





Why Join Aligned Advisors



- Work with a high-performing, growth-focused team



- Exposure to CFO-level strategy and advisory work



- Clear processes, strong leadership, and a culture of accountability



- Opportunity to grow within a specialized niche serving dental entrepreneurs

title: Accounting Supervisor
description:
About the Role:



We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Accounting Supervisor** to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership capabilities, excellent accounting knowledge, and prior experience handling U.S.-based accounting processes.



As the Accounting Supervisor, you will oversee the day-to-day accounting operations, ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, and support the continuous improvement of financial procedures. You’ll also be guiding a team of accounting associates to maintain compliance, efficiency, and accuracy across all financial activities.



Key Responsibilities:



* Supervise daily accounting operations, including bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, and general ledger maintenance.

* Review and approve journal entries, reconciliations, and financial statements.

* Ensure compliance with accounting principles and company policies.

* Oversee month-end and year-end closing processes.

* Coordinate with management for budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.

* Train, mentor, and evaluate accounting staff to ensure high performance and accuracy.

* Collaborate with external auditors and support audit requirements.

* Recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy in financial operations.



Qualifications:



* Minimum of 3–5 years of accounting experience, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory role.

* Strong understanding of U.S. accounting principles (GAAP).

* Proficient in QuickBooks, Excel, and other accounting software.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and leadership skills.

* Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Medical Education Content (TikTok/Instagram Reels)
description:
I'm a physician creating educational content on TikTok and Instagram Reels covering medical education, mentorship for aspiring doctors, and behind-the-scenes physician life. I need a short-form video editor who can be a long-term creative partner as this channel grows.

What you'd be doing: Editing 3-4 vertical videos per week, 30-90 seconds each. Formats include talking-head clips, voiceover laid over medical studies, journal figures, or diagrams (with zooms, highlights, and text annotations to keep static images visually engaging), and occasional screen-recording segments. You'd handle cuts, pacing, captions, text overlays, transitions, and basic color/audio cleanup. Turnaround is 48 hours per video.

The style I'm going for: Fast-paced educational content with punchy cuts, bold captions, and strong visual pacing. Think clean and professional, not vlog-style, cinematic, or beauty/gaming content. I'll share specific style references and a detailed style guide once you're onboarded.

Tools: CapCut is the primary editor. Familiarity with DaVinci Resolve is a plus but not required.

Medical accuracy matters: This is healthcare content. Captions must spell medical terms, drug names, and conditions correctly. If you're not comfortable looking up unfamiliar terminology to get it right, this role will frustrate you.

Communication: We'll work through Google Drive for file sharing and WhatsApp or
 for feedback. I'll provide organized raw footage folders with clear naming conventions.

To apply, include:



Links to 3-5 short-form videos you've edited (TikTok, Reels, or Shorts, not long-form)

Mention "navy scrubs" somewhere in your application so I know you read this fully

Your hourly rate or preferred monthly rate for 10-15 hours per week

One sentence on why educational content interests you

title: Billing Operations Lead (Project Lifecycle Tracking Accounting/Reconciliation/Bookkeeping)
description:
-- About the Business --



Our business coordinates service requests for commercial clients, connecting them with qualified vendors for maintenance, repair, cleaning, and other trade-related work.



After the work is completed, our department organizes the vendors’ reports, reviews the details for accuracy, and prepares clear client-ready reports and invoices. Our goal is to make sure every job is tracked properly from request through completion, documentation, billing, and payment.



-- The Opportunity --



Our department is growing fast, and we're looking for a Billing Operations Lead to work directly with leadership — overseeing, running, and improving our billing system.



Big picture: While the foundational systems are already built, we're continuing to upgrade and refine the system right under our feet. Because we are managing a high volume of moving parts while also improving the larger workflow, we need a steady, organized anchor - you - who can help keep operations moving with accuracy, consistency, and care.



You will track incoming jobs through their full lifecycle (from AP to AR), delegate clear step-by-step tasks by updating SOPs and using ClickUp for project management, escalate harder questions to management, and overall keep the machine running smoothly with reminders, follow-ups, and creative solutions to any and every challenge.



The person who thrives here takes pride in maintaining an accurate, complete, clean, well-run system, enjoys creating order out of chaos, loves seeing a project through from beginning to end, and holds themselves to a high personal standard.



As the business scales, there is real opportunity to grow with it and shape your own role.



-- Job Description --



We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented professional to run our company billing lifecycle — and to care about it like it's their own.



This is not a role where you'll be handed a finished manual. Our systems are live and still evolving, and they'll keep changing as we grow.



We need a self-starting problem-solver who can keep daily progress steady while adapting smoothly to new steps and new tools — someone who reads an unclear situation, uses good judgment, and figures out the next right move — someone who operates independently but also knows when to reach out for guidance and clarity.





-- This Role Is PERFECT For You If: --



* You have an analytical mind and love putting together puzzles and creating order out of chaos

* You have high personal standards

* You take deep pride in a clean, accurate, complete, well-running system

* You love the whole picture. There's a real satisfaction for you in tracking a job from a simple request all the way to a finalized, paid invoice — and you don't fully relax until the loop is closed.

* You take pride in your work — and being part of a team. You want to see the system run beautifully regardless of credit. You are a natural two-way leader, meaning you can give direction to assistants, while hearing their input, and bring solutions and suggestions to leadership, while taking direction from them as well.

* You start your own engine. You don't need a manager checking in on every step. You look at what needs doing, and you go. But you also know when to slow down and ask for guidance and clarity, with your own suggestions at hand.

* You're calm in ambiguity. When something isn't mapped out, you don't freeze — you use logic, context, and judgment to find the next best step, then flag it so we can document it.

* You're built for consistency. You've got the focus and stamina to hold a high standard day after day, not just in bursts.

* You enjoy being part of a growing business where the role and responsibility can expand over time.

* You have a natural curiosity about how field-service work gets done and either know or can quickly pick up the vocabulary of mechanical, electrical, repair, or cleaning work, enough to catch a billing error before it reaches a client.



-- Please Do NOT Apply If: --



- You need a finished manual or daily supervision to know what to do next.

- You'd rather move fast and cut corners than protect accuracy and data integrity.

- Routine bores you and you prefer to work in sprints.

- It stresses you out when systems and workflows are being actively built, changed and improved around you.



-- Compensation & Logistics --



$1,200 USD/month to start, full-time. *If you're the right fit, I'm genuinely open to hearing what feels right, good, and fair to you. I believe in open communication and all parties feeling comfortable bringing up their preferences and expectations.*



A 90-day review with real room to grow — in both pay and responsibility — as you take on more ownership.



A discretionary year-end bonus. I prefer steady, dependable pay over short-term incentives, so you can focus on doing great work.



Independent contractor role (no benefits).



Mostly independent schedule. I'm in the US Eastern time zone. A couple of hours of overlap (your evening) is helpful while you're getting up to speed and for occasional real-time questions — but it's a preference, not a hard requirement.



-- To Apply --



Please send me a short, genuine message answering these:



1. Tell me about a time you stepped into a role where the existing processes were unorganized or nonexistent. What was the high-level goal you were given, how did you figure out the underlying issues on your own, and what system did you build to keep things running smoothly every day?



2. What's your experience with billing, invoicing, job or work-order tracking, or coordinating other people's work?



3. How do you keep your own work accurate and moving when there are a lot of tasks and details to track at once?



Please also include:



1. Your resume, with the file named: LastName_FirstName - BillingLead.pdf



2. A url link to your result of this 10-15 minute work-personality assessment: 
 (you *do not* need to provide your
 / details when it suggests) and begin your subject for this whole message / application with the two top letters in order of highest percentage first (e.g., DC), followed by your info in this format: [ - Billing Operations - LastName_FirstName].



3. Your availability/hours (preferred and any flexibility you have)



4. Any tools you've used — Google Sheets, Excel, ClickUp, CRMs, invoicing or job-tracking systems.



5. Anything else you'd like me to know and consider.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid trial task.

title: Pinterest Manager - Visual Product Catalog (Long-Term)
description:
We're a US-based business that makes laser-cut stencils — both custom designs and a large catalog of pre-designed stencils. We have a Pinterest account that's been inactive for a few years, plus a large library of existing project photos and videos. We're looking for someone reliable to take full ownership of Pinterest, revive the account, and grow it into a steady source of traffic to our website.

This is an ongoing, long-term role for the right person. We're looking for consistency week after week, not a one-time cleanup.

What you'll do

To start, you'll work entirely from our existing content. That means:



Auditing the current Pinterest account — identifying any old pins still getting impressions and refreshing them, and cleaning up or removing what isn't working.

Organizing the account into clear, well-named boards (for example: wedding signage, nursery decor, home decor, business/logo projects, and so on).

Using our existing photo and video library to create fresh, attractive pins — including video pins and before/after or in-progress project pins, which tend to perform best.

Writing keyword-optimized pin titles, descriptions, and board names so our content gets found in Pinterest search.



Once our new pre-designed catalog goes live on the website, you'll move into the second phase: creating pins for those new designs and organizing them into boards that match how the products are grouped on our site.

All pins should link to our website. Every pin needs a trackable link (we'll show you how) so we can see what's driving traffic.

What we're looking for



Real experience managing a Pinterest account for a business, ideally one that sells visual or home/craft products.

A genuine understanding that Pinterest is a search engine, not just a social network — meaning you know how Pinterest SEO and keywords work, not just how to repost images.

Comfort creating fresh pin graphics from existing photos and video (basic Canva-level design is fine).

Strong written English for pin descriptions and titles.

Consistency and the ability to work independently once you understand our brand and goals.



Nice to have



Experience with Pinterest Trends or keyword research tools.

Familiarity with UTM links or basic traffic tracking.

An eye for the kind of clean, project-focused content that DIY and home-decor audiences save and share.



Details



Rate: $5/hour

Hours: [flexible — fill in how many hours/week you want to start with]

Long-term, ongoing role with room to grow as the account does.

I am looking for an experienced GoHighLevel freelancer to build a clean, organized multi-brand customer review automation system inside a NEW GoHighLevel account.

s and SMS messages

* routes negative customers to an internal feedback form

Goals



The new system must:



* support 3 separate brands

* use generic messaging initially

* allow the customer to select which company they worked with

* then ask if the experience was positive or negative

* route customers dynamically based on company selection and response

1. Zenbooker Webhook Integration



* Receive webhook from Zenbooker after completed appointments

* Properly map customer data into GoHighLevel

System MUST respect:



* SMS opt-in status

*
 opt-in status

* DND/unsubscribe logic



Examples:



* If customer is opted into SMS only ? send SMS only

* If customer is opted into
 only ? send
 only

* If customer is opted into BOTH ? send BOTH SMS and

* If neither ? do not send messages



3. Review Request Messaging



Create:



* SMS template

*
 template

 Requirements:

 replies should either:

    * forward to 

        OR

4. Expiring Review Link & Reminder Logic



The review/survey link should:



* expire after use

* stop all future automated reminder messages once clicked



The system must track whether the customer has clicked the survey/review link.



Reminder Logic:



* Initial message sent after completed appointment

* If link is NOT clicked on Day 1 ? send follow-up reminder on Day 2

* If still NOT clicked ? send final reminder on Day 5

Customer clicks review request link ?

Selects which company they worked with ?

Selects positive or negative experience



If Positive:

? Redirect to the correct Google Review page based on selected company



If Negative:

? Redirect to a shared internal feedback form

* customer full name

*
 address

All fields must be required.



The form should feel neutral and professional and should not prominently reference any specific brand.



When submitted, the feedback form must automatically
 the submitted feedback to:

IMPORTANT:

I want this account built CLEANLY and professionally.



Please use:



* folders

* clear workflow names

* organized funnels/forms

* tags/custom fields

* reusable logic where appropriate



Examples:



* WF - Review Request Master

* WF - Positive Review Routing

* Funnel - Review Gateway

8. Testing



You must:

* test reminder logic

showing how the system works so I can manage it later.

Preferred:
